title: Digital Ad Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Proadept Academy offers premium courses in technology and creative disciplines designed to help learners build future-ready skills. The academy focuses on practical, industry-relevant training that supports career growth and professional development. Learners gain access to expert-led sessions, curated curricula, and real-world projects that enhance their portfolios. Proadept Academy aims to create a supportive learning environment where individuals can scale up their professional journey with confidence and clarity.
  
**Role Description**
The Digital Ad Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata, responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns across platforms such as Google, Meta, and other relevant ad networks. The specialist will manage end-to-end campaign workflows, including audience targeting, keyword research, ad creation, budget allocation, bid management, and performance tracking. Daily tasks include monitoring campaign metrics, preparing performance reports, running A/B tests on creatives and copy, and recommending data-driven improvements to increase ROI. The role also involves collaborating with marketing and content teams to align ads with broader digital strategies, landing pages, and brand messaging, while ensuring campaigns comply with platform guidelines and organizational standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills for data interpretation, performance analysis, and optimization of digital ad campaigns.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for clear reporting, cross-functional collaboration, and coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Digital Strategy and Digital Marketing skills to design, implement, and refine multi-channel advertising initiatives.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to handle multiple campaigns, timelines, budgets, and deliverables efficiently.
* Experience with major ad platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and familiarity with tracking tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Tag Manager) is beneficial.
* Ability to work with spreadsheets and dashboards to manage budgets, KPIs, and reporting is preferred.
* Relevant education or certifications in marketing, advertising, or digital media are an advantage.
* Attention to detail, willingness to learn, and a results-focused mindset are highly valued.

title: Ecommerce Specialist
description:
Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager – Ecomhub24

**Company:**
FlixooLive – Ecomhub24

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Ecomhub24

**Ecomhub24 is the e-commerce enablement and brand-scaling division of FlixooLive.**

We partner with consumer brands to launch, manage and scale their businesses across
**Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Ajio and other digital marketplaces**
.

Our ecosystem combines marketplace management, cataloguing, pricing, advertising, inventory planning, warehousing, fulfilment, analytics and growth strategy.

Our vision is to build and manage a portfolio capable of generating
**10,000+ orders per day**
.

The Role

We are looking for a
**Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager**
who can take complete ownership of the growth and performance of brands managed by Ecomhub24.

This is not just an account-management role. We want someone who can
**think like a business owner**
, understand numbers, identify growth opportunities and build systems that can scale brands profitably.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the
  **monthly growth and overall performance**
  of assigned brands.
* Manage brands across multiple marketplaces and categories.
* Develop and maintain
  **brand-wise, marketplace-wise and SKU-wise P&L sheets**
  .
* Build effective
  **inventory planning, replenishment and stock management systems**
  .
* Develop
  **pricing, discounting, margin and promotional strategies**
  .
* Establish listing and cataloguing guidelines for different marketplaces.
* Monitor and improve product listings, content, keywords, images and marketplace compliance.
* Plan and optimise
  **marketplace advertising campaigns**
  .
* Track ROAS, ACOS, contribution margins and advertising profitability.
* Analyse sales, returns, cancellations, inventory ageing and SKU-level profitability.
* Identify
  **hero products, underperforming SKUs and new growth opportunities**
  .
* Coordinate with cataloguing, warehouse, operations, advertising and marketplace teams.
* Develop and maintain
  **SOPs, dashboards and reporting systems**
  .
* Conduct weekly and monthly brand performance reviews.
* Maintain proactive communication with partner brands.
* Ensure partner brands receive transparent reporting, actionable growth plans and strong operational support.
* Take ownership of
  **partner satisfaction, retention and monthly growth**
  .

What Success Looks Like

Over the first
**6 months**
, the objective will be to create the systems, strategies and execution capability required to scale selected existing brands towards approximately
**100–500 orders per day**
, depending on category, inventory and marketplace potential.

The larger Ecomhub24 mission is to build a diversified brand portfolio capable of generating
**10,000 orders per day**
.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in:

* E-commerce marketplace management
* Brand/account management
* Marketplace advertising
* Inventory planning
* Pricing and profitability
* P&L management
* Cataloguing and listings
* Sales analytics and reporting
* Marketplace operations

Experience in
**fashion, apparel, kidswear, lifestyle or consumer categories**
will be preferred.

You should be
**analytical, commercially minded, execution-driven and comfortable taking ownership of numbers and business outcomes**
.

Why Ecomhub24?

We are currently building Ecomhub24 into a large-scale e-commerce growth and fulfilment ecosystem.

This role offers an opportunity to work directly on multiple brands, build processes from the ground up and grow into a larger
**leadership position**
as Ecomhub24 expands.

We are particularly interested in people who have experience
**scaling brands rather than simply maintaining marketplace accounts**
.

Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and mention:

**Current CTC | Expected CTC | Notice Period | Current Location | Marketplaces Managed | Largest Brand/Account Managed | Highest Monthly Orders/GMV Managed**

**Ecomhub24 — E-commerce Enablement & Brand Scaling Division of FlixooLive**

title: Advertising Copywriter
description:
**Company Description**
Brrandom is a full-service integrated branding, creative advertising, and digital marketing agency with offices in Kolkata, India and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The agency focuses on using data-driven insights to make marketing efforts more effective, efficient, and closely aligned with clients’ business goals. Brrandom has grown rapidly in a competitive digital marketing landscape by offering innovative, result-oriented services. By combining years of experience with current trends, and blending technology with creativity, the team delivers measurable ROI and adds value to clients’ brands.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Advertising Copywriter role based in Kolkata. The Advertising Copywriter will develop compelling copy for campaigns across digital, social, and traditional channels, including ads, landing pages, emails, and brand messaging. Responsibilities include collaborating with designers and marketers to create integrated concepts, crafting scripts for video and audio content, and adapting copy to different audiences and platforms. * Candidates should possess Scriptwriting and Creativity Skills to develop engaging concepts and stories for advertising campaigns.
* Candidates should possess Marketing knowledge to align copy with brand positioning, campaign objectives, and digital marketing best practices.
* Candidates should possess excellent command of English, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in collaborating with cross-functional teams and openness to feedback and iterative improvement.
* Candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in an advertising or digital agency environment and familiarity with social media and performance-driven campaigns is beneficial.

title: Practice Development Manager, Ortho Kolkata
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-Field based
  
  
**Description**
**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
  
  
As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare | Medical Technology | Digital Transformation | Business Consulting | Practice Growth | Customer Success | Commercial Leadership
  
  
This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
  
  
**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales -**
At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
  
  
**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare -**
Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.
  
  
**Be Part of India's Growth Story -**
India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.
  
  
**Role expectations**
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Territory Growth**

* Develop and execute strategic territory plans using customer insight, commercial data, and opportunity analysis.
* Grow existing customer partnerships while acquiring and activating new customers.
* Convert new and existing practices into advocates of digital orthodontics and clear aligner treatment.
* Identify high-potential opportunities and prioritize activities that drive sustainable business growth.

**Become a Strategic Business Partner**

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.
* Understand each customer's clinical, commercial, and patient-focused objectives.
* Act as a strategic advisor rather than a transactional seller.
* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
**The Strongest PDMs Are**
**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**
They help shape the future of digital dentistry by expanding adoption and influencing change.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
**Who We're Looking For**
We would love to hear from professionals with experience in: Medical Devices | Healthcare Technology | Diagnostics | Capital Equipment | Dental Technologies | Orthodontics | Healthcare Solutions | Complex Consultative Sales
  
  
You will thrive in this role if you are: Commercially sharp and growth oriented | Highly customer focused | Curious and quick to learn | Resilient in competitive environments | Strong at relationship building | Passionate about technology and innovation | Motivated by business transformation rather than transactional selling
  
  
**A Message to Medical Device Professionals**
Many candidates initially view digital dentistry as a niche category. We see it differently.
  
  
While the category is specialized, the capabilities you build are broad and highly transferable. As a Practice Development Manager, you will develop expertise in strategic selling, customer transformation, digital adoption, territory leadership, commercial strategy, and market development.
  
  
**Digital dentistry is the category you enter. Healthcare transformation is the capability you build.**
**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means:
  
  

* Building a healthy, high-performing territory
* Expanding customer adoption of clear aligner treatment
* Accelerating digital workflow adoption
* Strengthening doctor and practice partnerships
* Turning customer insight into business growth
* Helping practices improve outcomes for patients and teams alike

Review our
**Applicant Privacy Policy**
for additional information.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all our practices, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected category. title: CYBER DEFENCE ANALYST L2 (D/F/M)
description:
**Job Description**
Diese Position ist in unserem spezialisierten Cyber Defense Center für Managed Security Services angesiedelt. Gemeinsam stellen wir die 24/7-Sicherheitsüberwachung sicher und sorgen für eine robuste, zukunftssichere digitale Abwehr komplexer Cyberangriffe
  
  
**Aufgabenbeschreibung**

* Überwachung von SOAR, SIEM, EDR/XDR und Netzwerk-Telemetrie zur Erkennung von Anomalien, Richtlinienverstößen und Angreifer-Techniken (MITRE ATT&CK)
* Durchführung fundierter technischer Analysen, Dokumentation und Triage von Sicherheitsereignissen und Alerts
* Untersuchung von Sicherheitsvorfällen unter Nutzung von Threat Intelligence und Vulnerability Assessments
* Ausführung erster defensiver Eindämmungsmaßnahmen
* Unterstützung von Threat-Hunting-Aktivitäten unter Verwendung von Cyber Threat Intelligence Inputs
* Unterstützung des Detection Engineerings durch Vorschläge zur Regeloptimierung und Aktualisierung von Playbooks basierend auf wiederkehrenden Alarmen
* Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Security Use Cases und operativen Playbooks
* Erstellung erforderlicher Dokumentation und Präsentation der Arbeitsergebnisse

**Erforderliche Qualifikationen**
Die Arbeitsaufgabe erfordert Kenntnisse und Fertigkeiten, wie sie in der Regel durch eine einschlägige mindestens dreijährige abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich IT und umfangreiche fachspezifische Zusatzqualifikation erworben werden. Gleichgestellt werden Kenntnisse und Fertigkeiten, wie sie in der Regel durch eine qualifizierte Weiterbildung (z.B. Techniker, Betriebswirt) erworben werden. Dazu gehören auch Meister oder Fachwirte mit zusätzlichen Aufgaben wie z.B. Führungsaufgaben und fachlicher Verantwortung für unterstellte Mitarbeiter. Die insgesamt erforderlichen Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen können auf andere Weise erlangt worden sein
  
  
**Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen**

* Praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Sicherheitsüberwachungsplattformen (z. B. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR-Lösungen (z. B. Microsoft Defender XDR, HarfangLab, Palo Alto Cortex XDR) und Log-Analyse-Tools
* Fähigkeit zur Analyse von Raw Logs (Syslog, Firewall, DNS, Proxy, Authentifizierung) sowie zur Durchführung grundlegender Packet-inspection
* Praktische Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Bereich Security Analysis
* Solides Verständnis von Netzwerkprotokollen, Betriebssystem-Interna (Windows & Linux), Active Directory und gängigen Angriffstechniken (MITRE ATT&CK Framework)
* Zertifizierungen wie Microsoft SC-200, Splunk Core User, Splunk Power User, Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst, Blue Team Level 1, Blue Team Level 2, Palo Alto Zertifizierungen, CISSP, CEH, GCIH oder GCFA sind ein Plus
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Für diese Tätigkeit ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. muss eine solche von den zuständigen Behörden erteilt werden
  
  
**Standort**
Der Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Landeshauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten
  
  
**Deine Vorteile**

* Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Faire und attraktive Vergütung sowie Sonderzahlungen
* 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
* Intensive Einarbeitung und fachkundige Begleitung im Rahmen des Onboardings in Form eines personalisierten Onboardings mit einer/einem persönlichen Mentor/in
* Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und vielversprechende Entwicklungsperspektiven
* Attraktive Sozialleistungen und Angebote u. a. arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Bike Leasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
* Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen (abhängig vom Standort) z. B. Kantine und Cafeteria, Fitness Studio, standortnaher Kindergarten, betriebsärztlicher Dienst und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen

title: Senior Manager- Taxation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role-**
Senior Manager – Taxation (Direct, Indirect & Cross-Border)

**Location**
: Kolkata (On-site)

: 10–12+ years post-qualification

: Chartered Accountant (strongly preferred); CS/CMA with equivalent tax exposure

considered

: 10–12 professionals

**About the role**

We are hiring a Senior Manager – Taxation to own end-to-end direct tax, indirect tax, and books-of-

accounts finalisation for a substantial client portfolio, while leading a delivery team of 10–12

professionals. This is a senior, people-leadership role: you will be the final technical checkpoint before

client sign-off and the primary career and delivery manager for your team, not an individual-contributor tax role with reporting responsibilities bolted on.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on expertise across direct tax and GST, is comfortable finalising books of accounts independently, and has working exposure to basic transfer pricing and cross- border/international taxation — gained either through client work or through working alongside a specialist team.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Direct Tax**

• Independently manage direct tax compliance, planning, and advisory for a portfolio of corporate and cross-border clients.

• Review and finalise income tax computations, returns, and tax positions taken by the team.

• Handle income tax notices, assessments, and departmental proceedings, including drafting responses and representing at hearings where required.

• Identify tax risk and planning opportunities proactively for clients and escalate material exposures to the Principal.

**Indirect Tax (GST & TDS)**

• Own GST compliance end-to-end: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns (GSTR-9/9C) and reconciliations for the portfolio.

• Review and resolve GST reconciliation discrepancies before they reach the client.

• Oversee TDS compliance, filings, and correction workflows across the team.

• Manage GST and TDS notices and departmental queries end-to-end.

**Finalisation of Accounts & Financial Reporting**

• Independently finalise books of accounts, financial statements, MIS, schedules, and reconciliations for clients of varying complexity.

• Ensure accurate, on-time month-end and year-end closures across the portfolio.

• Identify accounting discrepancies early and drive timely resolution with the team and the client.

• Support and coordinate statutory and internal audits, including liaising directly with auditors.

**Transfer Pricing & Cross-Border Taxation**

• Apply working knowledge of basic transfer pricing concepts — arm's length principle, benchmarking basics, Form 3CEB requirements — to flag and route TP-relevant transactions correctly.

• Support cross-border tax compliance and advisory for clients with international structures (Singapore, US, Dubai, and similar corridors).

• Coordinate with internal specialists and, where needed, external counsel on cross-border structuring, withholding tax, and DTAA positions.

• Build sufficient fluency in international tax fundamentals to review team output critically and identify when a matter needs specialist escalation.

**Team & Client Leadership**

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 10–12 accounting and taxation professionals across multiple client engagements.

• Own resource allocation, workload planning, and delivery quality across the team — this is a true managerial role with direct accountability for team output, not just technical review.

• Set and track individual goals for team members; conduct regular one-on-ones and performance

conversations.

• Act as the senior client-facing point of contact for escalations, complex queries, and relationship management within the portfolio.

• Drive process discipline, documentation standards, and continuous improvement within the practice.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Qualification**

• Chartered Accountant (CA) — strongly preferred.

• Company Secretary (CS) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) with strong, demonstrable direct tax, GST, and accounts finalisation experience will also be considered.

**Experience**

• 10–12+ years of relevant post-qualification experience in a CA firm, tax consultancy, or in-house tax/finance leadership role.

• Strong, hands-on experience across direct tax, indirect tax (GST/TDS), and finalisation of books of accounts — non-negotiable across all three.

• Working exposure to basic transfer pricing and cross-border/international taxation; deep specialisation not required, but working fluency is.

• Demonstrated experience managing and developing a team of 10 or more professionals, with clear ownership of delivery outcomes.

• Prior experience serving international or cross-border clients (Singapore, US, UK, Middle East) is a strong plus.

**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

* Self-starter with a drive to develop own skills and knowledge

title: Early Childhood Educator
description:
**About the role -**

Aroha Early Learning Community is a progressive, play-based early learning space preparing to open in Action Area 1, New Town, Kolkata. We believe childhood deserves time, space, freedom and respect, and we see children as capable, curious and full of potential.

We’re looking for thoughtful, empathetic and enthusiastic Early Childhood Educators to join our founding team in a full-time role. As one of our first educators, you will help build a preschool from the ground up, contributing to the culture, curriculum and learning environment of a new school while growing alongside a team committed to meaningful early childhood education.

Success in this role looks like children who feel safe, seen and free to explore; families who feel connected to and informed about their child’s learning; and a classroom practice that grows through observation, reflection and collaboration. Educators sit at the heart of Aroha. Your everyday work with children will shape how our philosophy comes to life.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and facilitate play-based learning experiences that respond to children’s interests, questions and developmental needs
* Create safe, welcoming environments that encourage exploration, independence and discovery
* Observe and document children’s experiences, learning and development
* Build warm, respectful relationships with children and communicate thoughtfully with families
* Collaborate with colleagues to plan classes, reflect on practice and develop the curriculum
* Contribute to the everyday life of the school and help shape Aroha’s approach to learning

**Qualifications**

* Must be 18 years of age or older
* Genuine curiosity about how young children learn, think, communicate and experience the world
* Respect for children as capable individuals, including their agency, ideas and perspectives
* A proactive, dependable, resourceful and thoughtful approach to work
* Empathy, patience, strong observation skills and openness to reflection and learning
* Enjoyment of collaboration, sharing ideas and reflecting on one’s own practice
* A background in early childhood education or a related field is an advantage, as is familiarity with progressive, play-based approaches
* Experience or training in the mental health field is preferred
* A specialisation in the creative arts (such as visual arts, music, movement, drama or expressive arts) is preferred



You don’t need to have followed a conventional path into education to apply. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds who are passionate about childhood and eager to deepen their understanding of early learning. For us, empathy, initiative, work ethic, openness to reflection and a willingness to learn matter just as much as existing knowledge and experience.

**How to apply**

Please fill in our application form: https://forms.gle/tFbYVMdom9vfiDu49

For any questions, write to us at operations@arohaearlylearning.com

title: Blender 3D Animator
description:
We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.

🎬 Role Description

Full-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, paired with a dedicated lighting artist who renders it and a lead who reviews your work.

📅 A typical week

One morning check-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.

You animate. Layout, body, expressions, lip sync, camera.

Your lead reviews before publish. Notes come back the same day.

Your lighting artist takes it from viewport to final render.

You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never blocked waiting for a review.

🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work

Render farm access. Your laptop is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.

A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.

An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.

Blender add-ons built in-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.

A named lead who reviews your work and unblocks you, not a queue.

A 200+ artist Discord where people actually answer.

💰 Compensation and how you grow here:

We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.

Tier 3 — ₹4,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2.

Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1.

Tier 1 — ₹8,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹80,000–₹96,000. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.

Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.

Two things worth saying plainly.

None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.

Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.

✅ Qualifications

You need to be strong in Blender at:

Layout and scene setup

Character animation — body mechanics, facial expression, lip sync

Camera animation

Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable

And you need to be someone who:

Can own a full video without being chased

Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly

Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.

Nice to have, not required: lighting and rendering.

We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF-mI

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb-qOTao

Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.

* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.

* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.

+ Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

* Physical Demand/Work Environment:

+ The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Required:

+ Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
+ Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
+ Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
+ Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
+ Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
+ Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.

* Preferred:

+ Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
+ Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.

ODRA Associated Pvt. Ltd. is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable surveying and geospatial solutions to clients across diverse sectors. The company emphasizes the use of modern technologies, including drone-based data collection, to improve accuracy, efficiency, and project turnaround time. ODRA Associated Pvt. Ltd. values safety, compliance, and professional integrity in all field operations and reporting. Team members are encouraged to innovate, collaborate, and continuously develop their technical skills to meet evolving industry standards. The company offers opportunities to work on varied projects within the Greater Kolkata Area and beyond.

The Drone Surveyor will plan and execute drone flights for land, infrastructure, and environmental surveys, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and regulatory requirements. * Candidates should possess competencies in data analysis and reporting, such as interpreting survey results, creating clear documentation, and preparing visual outputs for clients.
* Candidates should possess abilities in safety and regulatory compliance, including knowledge of local drone regulations, airspace restrictions, and field safety practices.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and interact professionally with clients.
* Relevant technical education (e.g., diploma or degree in surveying, civil engineering, geomatics, or related field) is beneficial.
* Prior experience in drone surveying, land surveying, construction monitoring, or related geospatial work is an advantage.
* Comfort with hybrid work, readiness for field travel within the Greater Kolkata Area, and the ability to work with minimal supervision are preferred.

* Strong troubleshooting skills covering performance issues, dumps, job failures, RFC issues, memory utilization, and system availability.

* Exposure to SAP Cloud environments including.
* Experience managing STMS and transport strategies in complex SAP landscapes.

* Experience with RISE with SAP environments.

* Effective time management, organizational skills, and ability to work under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all levels of team members, stakeholders, and customers
* Collaborative mindset to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Testing Strategy & Execution: Develop and oversee the execution of comprehensive testing strategies to validate data reports, exports, and end-of-study deliverables.
* Requirements & Protocol Consistency: Ensure report requirements and data transfer specifications are clear, testable, proofread, and consistent with clinical trial protocols.
* Data Entry & Test Cases: Perform accurate data entry with a focus on generating both positive and negative test cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of system validation scenarios.
* Data Mapping & Verification: Execute qualification testing on data mapping/exports and verify customer data clarification requests.
* Defect Tracking & Documentation: Document and track defects to resolution while ensuring all testing adheres to applicable processes and procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster effective communication and collaboration with developers, product managers, and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or needed.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Education / Experience: Associate degree or equivalent experience in software quality assurance, data testing, or related fields.
* Technical Skills:
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Process & Tool Knowledge: Experience with defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and adhering to structured test documentation processes.
* Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (written and verbal), ensuring clear and effective exchange with personnel at various levels.
* Personal Attributes: Detail-oriented, self-motivated, with strong organizational and prioritization skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

Additional Experience Desired:
  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, SAS, or Python is a plus.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of clinical trial protocols, data transfer specifications, or regulatory compliance standards.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Role purpose**

The Head of Operations runs the organisation day to day so the CEO can focus on strategy, partnerships and growth.

This person owns organisational effectiveness. They make sure teams deliver programmes and tasks on time, decisions get made and followed through, and performance is tracked against clear targets. They set up the structures, systems and dashboards that let a multi-state, multi-programme organisation run smoothly.

We are looking for a strong executor: someone who manages projects closely, keeps data current, coordinates teams and supports senior leadership with clear information and follow-up.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Programme delivery across the organisation**

* Track delivery of every programme against its annual and half-yearly (H1/H2) plan, budget and donor commitments.
* Run weekly and monthly delivery reviews with each vertical and program lead; flag delays early and agree corrective actions.
* Make sure donor reports, utilisation certificates and compliance deadlines are met on time, working with programme and finance teams.
* Coordinate shared resources (field staff, events) across verticals and states.

**2. Team performance**

* Set up and run the performance system: KRAs, weekly and monthly reviews and bi annual appraisals for all teams.
* Help vertical leads write clear KRAs and track them through the year.
* Support onboarding of senior hires with expectation notes, JDs and KRA trackers.
* Identify capacity gaps and work with HR on hiring, training and team structure.

**3. Systems, structures and decision-making**

* Define who decides what: approval limits, escalation paths and meeting rhythms (weekly leadership meeting, monthly reviews, quarterly planning).
* Write and maintain SOPs for core processes: procurement, travel, field operations, partner onboarding and document management.
* Make sure decisions from leadership meetings are recorded, assigned and closed.
* Work with Finance, HR and Admin to keep policies current and followed.

**4. Dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain an organisation-wide dashboard covering programme progress (activities and outputs), budgets, team KRAs, support team progress and key risks.
* Prepare monthly updates for the ON Sr Leadership and quarterly updates for the Board.

**5. Support to senior leadership**

* Act as the CEO's operational counterpart: prepare briefs, follow up on actions and keep priorities moving.
* Coordinate cross-team projects that need more than one vertical, such as new programme launches and multi-partner proposals.
* Represent the CEO in internal reviews and selected external meetings

**6. External relationships**

* Manage day-to-day operational relationships with donors, CSR partners, government departments and implementation partners.
* Make sure partner agreements, MOUs and reporting timelines are tracked and met.

**Who we are looking for**

**Experience**

* At least 15 years of work experience, with a significant part in operations leadership.
* Has led multiple teams at the same time, ideally across locations or states.
* Has run operations in a MNC/ development-sector organisation, social enterprise, CSR programme or a similar multi-programme or project setup.
* Has worked with donor-funded or CSR-funded programmes and their reporting and compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Project management: plans work, tracks timelines, and closes loops without being chased.
* Dashboards and data: comfortable building and maintaining trackers in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with tools like Power BI, Notion or Asana is a plus.
* Performance systems: has designed or run KRA, OKR or appraisal processes.
* Process design: writes clear, simple SOPs that field teams actually use.
* Communication: writes crisp updates for leadership and Boards; comfortable in English and Hindi; Bengali is a plus.

**Attributes**

* A strong executor who takes ownership and follows through.
* Calm under pressure and able to juggle many priorities.
* Builds trust with team leads while holding them to commitments.
* Comfortable with travel to field locations.
* Willing to work in a start-up like, unstructured environment

**Education**

* Graduate degree required; a postgraduate degree in management, rural management or development is preferred.

**Compensation**

The CTC for this role is ₹18–24 lakh per annum, based on experience.

**Why join us?**

* Run operations for green livelihoods programmes across India.
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team, and shape how the organisation runs and grows.
* Build the systems, dashboards and performance processes that every team will use.
* Work with national and international donors, CSR partners and government on programmes with real field impact.
* Join a Great Place to Work® certified organisation.

**About SwitchON Foundation**

Established in 2008, SwitchON Foundation is a pioneering non-profit organization committed to driving sustainable development through innovative solutions in climate-resilient agriculture, clean energy, green livelihoods, and industry decarbonization. With a passionate team of over 175+ professionals, we operate across 10 states in India, empowering communities with climate-smart technologies and practices.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, SwitchON Foundation takes pride in its inclusive and diverse workplace, with strong representation of women in leadership roles. Our impact is amplified through a combination of innovative programs, social enterprises, and strategic policy advocacy aimed at creating lasting change.

To learn more about our work, please visit:
www.switchon.org.in

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

title: Supply Planning Lead
description:
**Job Title: Supply Planning Lead**

**Location: Kolkata (Onsite - Work from Office)**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a
**Supply Planning professional to drive distribution and replenishment planning across warehouses and sales channels, ensuring optimal inventory levels, timely product availability, and efficient stock allocation in alignment with business requirements.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Drive
**distribution planning across warehouses and sales channels**
, ensuring optimal inventory deployment, product availability, and service levels.

• Develop and
**execute replenishment plans**
based on demand forecasts, stock cover, inventory norms, lead times, and warehouse-level requirements.

• Monitor inventory across locations,
**identify stock imbalances, ageing, excess and shortfall risks**
, and drive inter-warehouse transfers or replenishment actions as required.

•
**Coordinate with Demand Planning, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams**
to
**align supply availability with distribution priorities**
and business requirements.

•
**Track fill rates, stock-outs, inventory cover, replenishment adherence, and distribution KPIs**
; analyse deviations and implement corrective actions.

• Support
**allocation planning**
for new launches, promotions, seasonal demand, and peak periods to ensure timely product availability across channels.

• Drive planning accuracy, process standardization, system data quality, and continuous improvement in distribution and replenishment processes.

• Depending on seniority, lead planning reviews, optimize distribution strategies, and mentor or manage the supply planning team.

**Preferred Skills & Know-how:**

•
**Strong understanding of Distribution Planning, Replenishment Planning, Inventory Management, and Supply Chain Planning.**

• Proficiency in Advanced MS Excel and strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans.

•
**Ability to coordinate across multiple warehouses and sales channels**
in a fast-paced business environment.

**Experience Requirements:**

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Commerce, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.

• Relevant experience in Supply Planning, Distribution Planning, Replenishment Planning, or Inventory Management, with designation aligned to demonstrated capabilities.

•
**Experience in FMCG, Beauty & Personal Care, Consumer Goods, Retail, or E-commerce preferred.**

• Exposure to multi-location inventory planning, warehouse coordination, replenishment optimization, and planning KPI management preferred.

title: Area Manager - Technical Services (Concrete)
description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2024, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.76 billion.

**Job Description**

**Overview**

Lead and manage the Technical Services team responsible for providing technical solutions and product approvals for Sika admixtures across key customers, including ready-mix concrete producers, contractors and precast manufacturers. Drive technical excellence, customer satisfaction and business growth by guiding the team in product development, mix design optimization, troubleshooting and on-site technical support.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
:

* Lead, mentor and develop the Technical Services team to deliver high-quality technical support and customer solutions.
* Drive product approvals with new and existing customers in collaboration with Sales teams to support business growth.
* Understand customer and project requirements and guide the team in developing appropriate product and technical solutions.
* Provide technical direction on concrete mix design, product optimization and performance improvement.
* Oversee laboratory testing related to concrete, aggregates and cement, ensuring accuracy, quality and timely completion.
* Guide the team in troubleshooting customer complaints, identifying root causes and developing effective corrective actions.
* Ensure effective planning and execution of product demonstrations, trials and performance testing at customer sites.
* Partner closely with Sales and Product Development teams to support customer trials, product launches and technical validations.
* Review and analyze technical data, test results and recommendations to ensure sound decision-making and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Build strong technical relationships with key customers, contractors, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for product improvements and customized solutions based on customer feedback and market requirements.
* Develop technical capability within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies and competitor activities and translate relevant insights into technical and business actions.
* Ensure adherence to Sika's technical, quality, safety and compliance standards across laboratory and site activities.

**Qualifications**

* BE / Diploma Civil Engineering.
* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Admixtures.
* Must have good knowledge about concrete mix design.
* Experience in designing concrete mixes for various requirements and do batch corrections.
* Thorough knowledge about various chemical admixtures.
* Also, knowledge about different cements and supplementary cementitious materials, testing methods and standards related to cement and concrete

**Additional Information**

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: CA Article Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Rajesh Choudhary & Associates is a professional chartered accountancy firm offering audit, taxation, accounting, and advisory services to a diverse range of clients. The firm is committed to high professional standards, ethical practice, and timely service delivery. Team members work closely with clients to understand their business needs and provide practical, compliant solutions. The firm promotes continuous learning and professional growth for aspiring chartered accountants, offering exposure to varied assignments and industries. Joining the firm provides an opportunity to build strong technical foundations and develop a career in public practice.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site CA Article Assistant role based in Kolkata. The Article Assistant will support audit and assurance engagements, including vouching, verification of records, documentation, and preparation of working papers. Daily tasks will involve assisting in preparation and filing of tax returns, GST workings, TDS calculations, and other statutory compliances under guidance of seniors. The role includes maintaining books of accounts, preparing financial statements, reconciling ledgers, and helping with management reports and schedules. The Article Assistant will liaise with clients for data collection, clarify basic queries, and ensure accurate and timely completion of assignments. The position offers structured training, exposure to professional standards, and hands-on learning aligned with the CA Articleship program.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should be enrolled in or eligible for CA Articleship under the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) guidelines.
* Good understanding of basic accounting principles, journal entries, ledgers, and financial statements.
* Basic knowledge of direct and indirect taxation (Income Tax, GST, TDS) and related compliance processes is preferred.
* Ability to work with accounting and office software (e.g., MS Excel, Word; exposure to accounting packages or ERP systems is an advantage).
* Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret financial data and statutory requirements.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a professional approach to client interaction.
* Capacity to work under guidance, manage deadlines, and adapt to structured training and review processes.
* Commitment to ethical practice, confidentiality, and continuous professional learning.

Zan Services is a Kolkata-based digital solutions company that helps businesses scale through custom web and mobile applications, blockchain solutions, and performance-driven digital marketing. The team combines deep technical expertise with a results-focused mindset to support both startups and established enterprises across industries such as FinTech, e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, education, real estate, and more. Zan Services delivers end-to-end services including web development, app development, Web3 and blockchain solutions, and data-informed digital marketing strategies. The company is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and is MSME registered, reflecting a strong commitment to quality and information security. Serving clients globally, Zan Services offers professionals the opportunity to work on diverse, high-impact projects in a fast-evolving digital landscape.

**Role Description**
The Performance Marketer (Google and Meta Ads) is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata. The role involves planning, launching, and optimizing paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta platforms to drive measurable growth for clients across multiple industries. Day-to-day responsibilities include keyword research, audience segmentation, ad copy and creative coordination, bid and budget management, and continuous performance analysis using analytics and tracking tools. The Performance Marketer will collaborate closely with the marketing, design, and development teams to align campaigns with broader digital strategies and ensure accurate tracking through pixels, tags, and conversion events. The role also includes preparing performance reports, conducting A/B tests, and recommending data-backed improvements to maximize ROI and meet client goals.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess 3 Years strong performance marketing experience , including expertise in Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram).
* Candidates should possess skills in campaign strategy and optimization, such as keyword and audience research, funnel planning, A/B testing, and bid/budget management.
* Candidates should possess analytics and tracking skills, including use of Google Analytics, Meta Business Manager, conversion tracking, pixels, and data interpretation for decision-making.

description:
**Business Area:**

**Job Description:**
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
  
  
Cloudera is looking for an Infrastructure Support Engineer II to join our Cloud Operations team and help deliver a fast, reliable support service across our global infrastructure estate. This is a hands-on role at the front line of how our engineering and business teams get access to, and get answers about, cloud, on-premises and AI platform services.
  
  
You will own day-to-day operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, and you will be one of the first people in the company supporting our internal AI platform. You will also help build the runbooks, automation candidates and knowledge base that make the whole service faster over time. If you like solving problems quickly, writing down what you learned, and then removing the need to solve it again, this is a good fit.
  
  
This role reports into Cloud Operations and works closely with our platform engineering, FinOps and identity teams.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Support Engineer II you will:
  
  

* Own and resolve day-to-day cloud operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including access, identity, account lifecycle and resource queries
* Provide support for our internal AI platform, including access and key management, usage and quota questions, model availability, and onboarding new teams onto the platform
* Support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, handling user access, environment queries and documented break-fix, and escalating operational issues to the engineers who own the stack
* Triage, diagnose and resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues, escalating cleanly with good evidence when an issue needs platform engineering or architecture input
* Execute documented change against our cloud estate safely and accurately, and raise simple infrastructure-as-code changes for review
* Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles so that recurring requests become self-service
* Use AI-assisted tooling to triage, research and draft resolutions faster, while remaining accountable for the accuracy of every answer that reaches a requester
* Maintain the accuracy of our configuration management data and service catalog
* Maintain the inputs to our Infrastructure-As-Code and Github workflow.
* Handle first-line cloud cost and tagging questions, escalating complex optimization work to our FinOps team
* Own the handover between time zones so nothing is dropped between regions
* Identify the requests that should not exist and propose the automation that removes them

We're excited about you if you have:
  
  

* Two to four years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure support or IT support, across cloud or on-premises environments
* Working knowledge of AWS, plus Azure or Google Cloud
* Experience working a ticket queue in a service management tool, ideally ServiceNow
* Confidence at the command line and with Linux
* Excellent written communication, because most of this work is written
* A track record of following documented process accurately, and improving it where it falls short
* An interest in identity and access concepts such as SSO, IAM and single sign-on group management

Nice to have:
  
  

* Exposure to Github, Terraform or other infrastructure as code
* Exposure to cloud cost management or FinOps practices
* Experience using AI or large language model tooling in a professional setting
* An associate-level cloud certification

**What you can expect from us:**

* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development

We’re looking for people with expertise in Oracle GRC Manager to join our EY-GDS GRC Technology Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.

* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.

* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 8 to 10 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:

+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions.
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Rajlaxmi Cotton Mills Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing company operating in the textile sector, with a focus on consistent product quality and reliable delivery. The Quality Control Inspector collaborates closely with supervisors and other departments to improve overall product quality and process efficiency.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

So Tammy’s is a chef-led modern Mexican café known for handcrafted tacos, burritos, and desserts that highlight bold flavors and fresh ingredients.
