title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

title: MDR Team Lead (India)
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service.
  
  

* Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM.
* Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required.

Team Management:
  
  

* Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development.
* Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering.

Service Management:
  
  

* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service.
* Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service.

**Requirements:**

* Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment.
* 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
* 2+ years of experience leading a team.
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM).
* Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* This role may require working either a morning shift (6:30 AM–3:30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST).

**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.

description:
LOOKING FOR STELLAR TOP CANDIDATES
  
  
Position: Executive Assistant

Search Location: India│Philippines

: The Final Salary Offer depends on the client’s decision, interview results, and experience
  
  
**About The Client**
Our client is a global technology company that transforms mobility, delivery, and logistics infrastructure across hundreds of cities worldwide.
  
  
To support executive leadership within its global accounting and finance organizations, the company is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to provide direct, dedicated administrative management to three Senior Directors across United States time zones.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Executive Assistant to take ownership of executive calendar management, complex scheduling logistics, travel coordination, and core administrative support for three Senior Directors.
  
  
In this role, you will fill a critical operational support gap within a fast-moving, high-volume environment. You will act as the master controller of high-density executive calendars, managing conference room bookings, resolving scheduling conflicts across coast-to-coast time zones (PST and EST), and streamlining expense and procurement workflows. This position is strictly focused on core business administration and executive leverage—there is no personal assistant scope involved.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned, tech-savvy Executive Assistant with 5-8 years of experience supporting senior enterprise directors, high proficiency in Google Workspace, and a resilient, proactive "Get Stuff Done" (GSD) mindset.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Primary Focus: Core business administration, multi-director calendar management, room bookings, expense reports (Ramp), procurement tracking (Zip), and travel logistics (strictly business, no personal admin)
  
  
Executive Calendar & Schedule Management
  
  

* Manage, maintain, and protect high-density, multi-time-zone master calendars for three Senior Directors (based in San Francisco and Florida).
* Proactively resolve scheduling conflicts across Pacific and Eastern time zones, ensuring appropriate buffer times and preparation windows.
* Coordinate multi-attendee internal syncs, cross-functional leadership reviews, and external partner meetings.
* Reserve, manage, and confirm physical conference rooms and virtual meeting links across enterprise office locations.
* Monitor incoming meeting requests and priority calendar changes, exercising sharp judgment to balance competing priorities.

Expense Management & Procurement Administration
  
  

* Prepare, submit, and track executive expense reports accurately using expense management software (Ramp).
* Assist with procurement requests, purchase orders, and vendor invoice processing through enterprise procurement systems (Zip).
* Ensure all business travel, meal, and operational expenses adhere strictly to corporate accounting policies and documentation guidelines.
* Track open procurement approvals and follow up with internal stakeholders to keep operational requests moving forward.

Core Business Administrative Support
  
  

* Manage executive travel arrangements, flight itineraries, hotel bookings, and ground transportation logistics.
* Prepare, format, and review internal documentation, meeting agendas, and executive briefs using Google Docs and Sheets.
* Provide responsive communication triage across Gmail and Slack, flagging urgent messages and routing inquiries to appropriate leads.
* Author clear meeting summaries, capture key action items, and maintain organized digital team archives.
* Maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive financial, organizational, and executive information.

**Requirements**

* 5-8 years of professional experience as an Executive Assistant supporting Senior Directors, Vice Presidents, or C-suite leaders within enterprise or fast-paced technology organizations.
* High proficiency with Google Workspace applications (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Meet).
* Proven experience managing complex, high-density calendars across multiple time zones (PST / EST) simultaneously.
* Practical experience using enterprise expense management software (Ramp) and procurement platforms (Zip or similar ERP systems).
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with high professional poise, executive presence, and clarity.
* A proactive, highly resourceful "Get Stuff Done" (GSD) attitude with a strong ability to solve problems independently.
* Meticulous attention to detail with an obsessive focus on calendar accuracy and follow-through.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection, secure computer setup, and a dedicated, quiet remote workspace.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience supporting global finance, accounting, or enterprise corporate operations teams.
* Experience navigating large-scale matrixed organizations with 500+ employees and distributed contractor bases.
* Track record of managing executive travel and room bookings across global corporate campus networks.

**Technology & Tools**
Candidates should be proficient with or capable of quickly mastering:
  
  

* Google Workspace (Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive)
* Ramp (Expense Management Software)
* Zip (Procurement & Purchase Order Software)
* Team Communication Tools (Slack, Zoom)
* Corporate Travel Management Platforms

**What This Role Offers**

* Direct administrative partnership with Senior Directors within a world-class technology enterprise.
* High operational leverage, directly supporting executive productivity across key finance and accounting functions.
* Exposure to modern enterprise productivity, expense, and procurement stack platforms (Google Workspace, Ramp, Zip).
* A stable full-time position working consistent Pacific Standard Time business hours.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is an articulate, highly disciplined executive support professional who thrives in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.
  
  
They do not wait for instructions—they analyze calendars weeks in advance, spot room and time zone conflicts before they happen, and resolve them smoothly. They navigate Google Workspace effortlessly, process expenses in Ramp without delay, and communicate with clear, confident professionalism across all channels.
  
  
Most importantly, they bring a resilient, proactive "Get Stuff Done" energy every day, taking true ownership of core business administration so senior directors can stay focused on strategic leadership.

**GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.

title: Territory Manager (Kolkata)

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
As a Territory Manager based in Kolkata, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus on
**Retail promotion**
alongside vital
**Doctor/HCP support**
. You will champion our
**OTC (Over the counter)**
and
**OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription)**
portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.

* Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines
* HCP Support: Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through targeted scientific communication, relationship building, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and support OTX prescriptions
* Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials
* Merchandising & Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy
* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Kolkata territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Our People & Places Solutions business – reinforces our drive to improve the lives of people everywhere and epitomizes the "why" of what we do – the tremendous positive impact and value our solutions bring to our communities and society as a whole. From facilities delivering life-saving therapies and ensuring clean water to enabling the connection of people through all modes of transportation and providing access to technology – we're integrating a multitude of these solution elements to build the smart environments of tomorrow.
  
  
Start your Jacobs career with a company that inspires and empowers you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow.
  
  
At Jacobs, advanced facilities simplify our everyday lives, enabling technology to connect us. We push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected and more sustainable.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Experience of 12+ years in handling advanced facilities for the Pharmaceutical, FMCG, Microelectronics sectors and their associated R&D facilities.

Space planning per equipment sizes, logical movement of Personnel, Materials, Washing, Waste movement in the production facility. Ability to generate multiple options with minimal inputs from client, other disciplines.
* Planning should be compliant with GMP requirements able to satisfy final validation requirements per inspecting agencies.
* Well versed with Plasma fractionation, Cell and Gene Therapy, Bio Pharma facilities catering to Vaccines, Hormones, Monoclonal antibodies and Therapeutic Enzymes. Apply experience and knowledge to design new facility types.
* Well versed with Micro Electronics facilities such as OSATs, FAB buildings and associated CUP, site utilities.
* Explain production facility concepts to clients, present various options for production facilities, material handling concepts, supporting utility options, site master planning, site development scenarios, and be able to get a buy in from the client on an option that satisfies the program objectives.
* Author the concept of personnel gowning requirements as applicable for the project. Incorporatesafety in design over and above statutory norms.
* Be ready to challenge client requirements or defend a proposed design option with a client on technical grounds to get the best solution as the result.

Full time Bachelor of Architecture (5 years, 10 semesters) from an Institute recognized by the COA India

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. * Monitor service health, performance, and availability; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests

* Implement and maintain security controls including MFA, Conditional Access, and data protection policies

* Implement governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive usage
* Integrate M365 with enterprise systems and third-party applications
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, and platform efficiency

**Automation & Documentation**

* Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell or native M365 tools
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Develop and maintain reporting dashboards for usage, health, and compliance

* Exchange Online

* OneDrive for Business

* Proven experience implementing Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation

* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Key Competencies**

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

* Focus on security, compliance, and operational excellence

title: Front Desk Receptionist
description:
**Company Description**
Guten Tag Kolkata is a backpacker hostel located in the Salt Lake City area of Kolkata, offering affordable and friendly accommodation to travelers from India and abroad. The hostel focuses on creating a welcoming, community-oriented environment where guests can meet, relax, and explore the city together. With common areas for socializing and practical facilities for longer stays, Guten Tag Kolkata caters to budget-conscious travelers who value connection and cultural exchange. Team members are encouraged to provide warm, helpful service and contribute to a safe, clean, and positive guest experience.
  
**Role Description**
The Front Desk Receptionist is a full-time, on-site role based at the hostel in Kolkata. The receptionist will be the first point of contact for guests, greeting arrivals, managing check-in and check-out, and providing information about the hostel and local attractions. Daily responsibilities include handling phone and in-person inquiries, maintaining reservation records, processing payments, and performing basic clerical and administrative tasks. The role also involves coordinating with housekeeping and other staff, responding to guest requests or concerns, and ensuring that the lobby and reception area remain clean, organized, and welcoming. The receptionist is expected to uphold hostel policies, maintain accurate documentation, and support a friendly and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer service and communication skills to interact effectively with diverse guests and colleagues.
* Proficiency in phone etiquette and core receptionist duties, including greeting visitors, handling inquiries, and managing reservations.
* Basic clerical skills such as record keeping, data entry, and managing documents or booking systems.
* Ability to speak and write clearly in English; knowledge of local languages (e.g., Bengali, Hindi) is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a hostel or hospitality environment, with a focus on guest satisfaction and safety.
* Organizational skills, reliability, and attention to detail when managing front desk operations and cash handling.
* Prior experience in reception, front office, or customer-facing roles in hospitality or service sectors is preferred.
* Flexibility to work hostel hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

title: Accounts and Inventory Executive- DTC Ecommerce
description:
Accounts & Inventory Executive

**Location:**
Kolkata | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2–5 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About the Role

1950 Origins is a growing premium Indian tea brand selling through Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, and its own website.

We are looking for an Accounts & Inventory Executive to manage daily accounting, marketplace settlements, stock reconciliation, tax compliance support, and management reporting. This role requires someone who understands how sales, payments, platform deductions, and inventory connect.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Maintain day-to-day books of accounts in Tally Prime.
* Record sales, purchases, expenses, payments, receipts, and journal entries.
* Perform bank reconciliations and maintain accurate customer and vendor ledgers.
* Track receivables, payables, payment deadlines, and outstanding balances.
* Maintain invoices, supporting documents, credit notes, and debit notes.

**E-commerce & Quick-Commerce Accounting**

* Reconcile sales, settlements, commissions, deductions, returns, and refunds across Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, and the company website.
* Match platform reports with bank receipts and accounting records.
* Verify platform fees, advertising deductions, logistics charges, penalties, and other expenses.
* Identify payment discrepancies and follow up with the relevant teams for resolution.
* Reconcile payment gateway settlements and COD collections, where applicable.

**Inventory Management & Reconciliation**

* Maintain SKU-wise records of raw tea, packaging materials, and finished goods.
* Record stock receipts, packing or production consumption, dispatches, returns, and transfers.
* Track inventory across company warehouses, third-party locations, and marketplace warehouses.
* Coordinate physical stock checks and reconcile quantities with Tally and internal records.
* Investigate shortages, damages, wastage, and stock discrepancies.
* Monitor batch-wise stock, ageing, expiry dates, and low-stock levels; flag replenishment requirements to operations.

**GST, TDS & Compliance Support**

* Prepare GST and TDS workings and coordinate timely payments and return filing with the CA.
* Reconcile GST input tax credit and follow up on missing invoices or mismatches.
* Reconcile marketplace TDS/TCS deductions with accounting records and relevant statements.
* Maintain compliance documentation, including e-way bills and e-invoices where applicable.
* Support audits, year-end closing, and other statutory requirements.

**MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, and financial reports.
* Maintain channel-wise revenue, expenses, settlement, and profitability reports.
* Track cost of goods sold, inventory valuation, logistics costs, and operational expenses.
* Assist with monthly P&L statements, cash-flow summaries, and budgets.
* Highlight unusual deductions, overdue payments, stock variances, and cost increases to management.

Skills & Qualifications

* B.Com or a relevant degree in Accounting or Finance.
* 2–5 years of relevant accounting experience.
* Strong working knowledge of
  **Tally Prime and Microsoft Excel is mandatory**
  .
* Ability to use Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP for reconciliation and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, bank reconciliation, and ledger management.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and accounting compliance.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to meet reporting deadlines independently.

Preferred Experience

Experience in a
**D2C, FMCG, food and beverage, retail, or e-commerce business**
is preferred. Hands-on settlement reconciliation experience with at least one marketplace or quick-commerce platform would be a strong advantage.

title: Sr Inspection Engineer (Fabrication)
description:
**Company Description**
Bureau of Audit and Consultancy is a professional services organization focused on delivering high-quality audit, inspection, and advisory solutions to industrial and infrastructure clients. The firm supports organizations in improving operational integrity, compliance, and performance through rigorous technical assessments and expert guidance. With a strong emphasis on engineering-led inspections, the Bureau combines practical field experience with systematic methodologies. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values accuracy, safety, and continuous improvement, offering opportunities for professional growth on complex projects.
  
**Role Description**
The Sr Inspection Engineer (Fabrication) is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata, responsible for overseeing and executing inspection activities related to fabrication projects. The role involves planning and conducting quality control checks, performing detailed inspections of fabricated components, and verifying compliance with engineering drawings, codes, and client specifications. The engineer will coordinate with fabrication teams, review test results, prepare inspection reports, and recommend corrective actions where needed. Daily tasks include monitoring fabrication processes, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, participating in technical meetings, and supporting audits and client reviews. The position requires collaboration with mechanical and electrical engineering stakeholders to resolve technical issues and maintain consistent documentation of inspection findings.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Quality Control and Inspection skills, with experience in fabrication projects and compliance with relevant standards.
* Candidates should possess Mechanical Engineering skills, including understanding of fabrication drawings, welding processes, materials, and structural components.
* Candidates should possess Electrical Engineering skills related to inspection of electrical systems, equipment interfaces, and basic circuitry in fabricated assemblies.
* Candidates should possess Testing skills, including planning and witnessing tests, interpreting results, and validating performance against specifications.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) and several years of experience in industrial or infrastructure fabrication inspection.
* Strong report-writing, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards (e.g., ASME, ASTM, ISO) and familiarity with non-destructive testing techniques is beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site in fabrication environments, manage multiple inspection activities, and uphold safety and ethical practices.

title: Piping Engineer
description:
Description - Internal
  
  
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Piping Engineer with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience.
  
  

* Piping Design & Layout Engineering:

+ Develop piping layouts for mining, mineral processing, and metal extraction facilities based on P&IDs, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and client specifications.
+ Ensure the layout design optimizes space, operational efficiency, and ease of installation while meeting industry safety and environmental standards.
+ Prepare detailed piping design drawings, including routing, support placement, and equipment integration.
+ Coordinate the layout of piping systems with other engineering disciplines such as civil, mechanical, and electrical to ensure seamless integration.
+ Select appropriate materials for piping systems based on factors such as fluid type, temperature, pressure, and environmental conditions.

* FEED (Front-End Engineering Design):

+ Participate in the FEED phase of projects, assisting in the development of piping layouts and preliminary designs
+ Work with multidisciplinary teams to define project scope, estimate costs, and identify potential design challenges.
+ Review client specifications and ensure the design aligns with technical, budgetary, and scheduling requirements.
+ Contribute to the development of initial piping design concepts, material take-offs, and cost estimates.

* Detailed Engineering Design:

+ Prepare detailed engineering designs for the full scope of piping systems, including pipe sizes, materials, valves, and fittings, as well as system integration.
+ Use S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar CAD software to develop accurate piping design drawings and layouts.
+ Coordinate with the stress analysis team to address any piping support and stress-related issues.
+ Ensure that all piping designs comply with applicable industry standards and codes (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, etc.).

* Layout Optimization:

+ Optimize piping layout designs for both new projects and modifications to existing plants by minimizing material usage, reducing installation time, and enhancing operational efficiency.
+ Review existing designs to identify potential areas for improvement and ensure that the piping layout adheres to best practices and operational needs.

* Coordination & Communication:

+ Work closely with internal teams, clients, contractors, and vendors to ensure the timely and successful completion of projects.
+ Participate in 3D design reviews, safety meetings, and project coordination meetings to track progress and mitigate risks.
+ Maintain clear and consistent communication regarding project milestones, design changes, and any potential challenges.

* Quality Control & Compliance:

+ Ensure the piping design meets quality standards and safety regulations in accordance with project requirements, local regulations, and industry codes.
+ Perform thorough checks to confirm design accuracy, material selection, and compliance with specifications.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in piping design, layout engineering, and detailed engineering in the mining, mineral, and metal industries or related heavy industries.
* Proficient in S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar 3D CAD software used for piping design.
* In-depth knowledge of piping codes and standards (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, ISO) and the ability to apply them effectively in design.
* Experience in FEED and detailed design phases of projects, from initial concept to final design.
* Familiarity with stress analysis and material selection for various operating conditions (pressure, temperature, and corrosion resistance).
* Strong understanding of piping layout principles, including routing, spacing, support design, and integration with equipment and structures.
* Experience working on large-scale mining or metallurgical plant projects.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Junior Payroll Executive
description:
About Super Iron Foundry

Super Iron Foundry is a Kolkata-headquartered manufacturer of cast iron and steel infrastructure products, including gratings, manhole and surface boxes, valve boxes, trench grates, steel fencing and tactile plates, supplying projects in India and international markets.

With five decades in operation, the company combines a large manufacturing workforce with a growing export business, and relies on accurate, compliant payroll to support both.

Role Overview

The Junior Payroll Executive will support end-to-end monthly payroll for head office and plant employees, maintain statutory compliance records, and serve as a first point of contact for employee salary queries.

The role suits a detail-oriented professional with hands-on payroll experience who wants to build depth in manufacturing-sector payroll and labour law compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll processing

* Collect and validate monthly attendance, leave, overtime and shift data from HR systems and plant supervisors
* Process monthly salaries and wages for staff and workers, including new joiners, exits, increments, arrears and deductions, loss of pay.
* Prepare salary registers, pay slips and bank transfer files for approval
* Support full and final settlements, including leave encashment, gratuity and bonus calculations
* Reconcile payroll figures with accounts before and after each cycle

Statutory compliance

* Calculate and prepare monthly challans and returns for Provident Fund (EPF), ESIC and West Bengal Professional Tax
* Assist with TDS on salaries, investment declarations, proof verification and Form 16 preparation
* Maintain registers and records required under applicable labour laws, including the Payment of Wages, Minimum Wages, Payment of Bonus and Payment of Gratuity Acts, and West Bengal Labour Welfare Fund
* Track minimum wage revisions and support compliance for contract labour, where applicable
* Keep documentation audit-ready for internal, statutory and labour department inspections

Employee support and reporting

* Respond to employee queries on salary, deductions, PF/ESI and tax in a timely, confidential manner
* Maintain accurate employee master data in the payroll system
* Prepare monthly MIS reports on headcount, payroll cost, overtime and statutory payments

Requirements

* Graduate in Commerce (B.Com) or equivalent; MBA/PGDM in HR or Finance is an advantage
* 1–3 years of payroll experience, preferably in a manufacturing or factory environment
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS on salary and core Indian labour laws
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliations)
* Experience with a payroll or HRMS platform and/or Tally
* High accuracy, discretion with confidential data, and ability to meet monthly deadlines
* Good written and spoken English, Bengali and Hindi (to support plant-level employees)

Preferred

* Exposure to multi-location payroll (head office and plant)
* Experience handling contract labour payroll and compliance
* Familiarity with EPFO and ESIC online portals

What the Role Offers

* Structured exposure to payroll and compliance in an established manufacturing organisation
* Direct learning under the head office HR and finance teams
* Statutory benefits as per company policy [add any others: medical insurance, bonus, etc.]

How to Apply

Send your CV to hr@superironfoundry.com and amit

@superironfoundry.com

with the subject line "Junior Payroll Executive – [Your Name]".

title: Injection Molding Operator
description:
**Company Description**
Plastochem Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing organization specializing in plastic components and related products for industrial and commercial applications. The company focuses on reliable production processes, consistent product quality, and timely delivery to its clients. Team members work with modern machinery and structured workflows designed for efficiency and safety. Plastochem encourages practical problem-solving, adherence to standards, and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Injection Molding HOF role based at the Plastochem facility in Kolkata. The Injection Molding Operator is responsible for setting up and operating injection molding machines, including adjusting parameters, loading materials, and monitoring equipment during production. Daily tasks include performing start-up, shut-down, and changeover procedures, inspecting molded parts for defects, and maintaining documentation related to production output. The role also involves performing basic preventive maintenance, reporting equipment issues, and following safety and quality guidelines. Collaboration with supervisors and quality personnel to meet production targets and resolve issues is an essential part of the position.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Machine Operation and Injection Molding, including setup, parameter adjustment, and safe handling of equipment.
* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Control, with the ability to inspect parts, identify defects, and follow quality standards and procedures.
* Candidates should possess skills in Injections and related molding processes, ensuring accurate material usage and consistent production cycles.
* Candidates should possess skills in Preventive Maintenance, including routine checks, minor adjustments, and basic troubleshooting of machines.
* Relevant experience in a manufacturing or plastics processing environment is preferred.
* Ability to read and follow work instructions, production schedules, and safety guidelines.
* Strong attention to detail, reliability in meeting shift requirements, and capability to work in a team-based production setting.
* High school diploma or equivalent; technical training in machine operation or plastics manufacturing is an advantage.

title: Corporate Strategy Analyst
description:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with more than 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges. We bring together a diverse and inclusive community of experts across regions and disciplines, fostering collaboration, professional growth, and meaningful global exposure. As a people-first organisation, ERM values well-being, career development, and the power of collective expertise to drive sustainable impact for our clients — and the planet.
  
  
**ERM Global Delivery Centre (GDC)**
We Deliver. We Synergise. We Innovate.
  
  
The Global Delivery Centre (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
  
  
At the GDC, you will:
  
  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.

**Why This Role Matters?**
Ready to help shape the strategic direction of a global market leader? Join ERM's newly established Corporate Strategy team and work alongside senior leaders to evaluate growth opportunities, assess investment priorities, and deliver insights that influence executive and Board-level decision-making. This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of strategy and finance while contributing to long-term enterprise value creation.
  
  
What Your Impact Is:
  
  

* Support the development of corporate strategy initiatives that drive sustainable growth and competitive advantage.
* Deliver market, competitor, and industry intelligence to identify risks, trends, and opportunities.
* Conduct financial, commercial, and operational analysis to support strategic business decisions.
* Develop data-driven recommendations that inform investment, capital allocation, and business performance priorities.
* Partner with cross-functional and global stakeholders to translate insights into actionable outcomes.
* Create executive-ready presentations, reports, and business cases for senior leadership audiences.
* Contribute to strategic projects that improve organisational performance and support business transformation.

**What You'll Bring:**
**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in corporate strategy, strategy consulting, strategic finance, investment banking, corporate development, or a similar analytical environment.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives such as market analysis, growth strategy, portfolio reviews, business performance analysis, or investment evaluation.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience preparing executive-level materials and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, M365 tools
* Excellent communication, research, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Commerce, or a related discipline.

**Well regarded**

* MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Professional certifications such as CFA, CA, CIMA, or similar.
* Experience in corporate development, M&A, private equity, or transaction advisory environments.
* Exposure to global organizations and matrixed operating environments.
* Experience leveraging AI, analytics, and data platforms to support strategic decision-making and enable productivity

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct market research, competitive intelligence, and industry analysis to identify strategic opportunities and risks.
* Analyse financial, commercial, and operational performance data to support business growth and investment decisions.
* Develop business cases, strategic assessments, and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Support capital allocation reviews, portfolio analysis, and long-term planning initiatives.
* Perform organisational diagnostics and performance assessments to identify improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Finance, Corporate Development, Commercial, Industry, Service, and Regional teams on strategic projects.
* Prepare high-quality presentations, reports, and executive briefings that simplify complex analyses into actionable insights.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies that may impact business strategy.

title: Technical Support Specialist/ Process Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cool Caps Industries is Eastern India’s largest manufacturer of beverage packaging and recycling solutions, providing caps, PET preforms, handles, and shrink film as a comprehensive raw material partner. The company integrates advanced recycling processes to produce high-quality RPET flakes from scrap plastic bottles and is investing in future B2B bottle-to-bottle initiatives using RPET granules. With operations across Uttarakhand, Assam, West Bengal, and Odisha, Cool Caps Industries supports a wide regional industrial footprint. The organization maintains a recycling capacity of over 15,000 MT and packaging capacity of over 25,000 MT, enabling scale and reliability for its customers. Team members join a growth-focused environment dedicated to innovation and sustainability in the packaging sector.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Technical Support Specialist/Process Engineer role is based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves monitoring and optimizing production processes for beverage packaging and recycling lines, ensuring stable operations, quality standards, and safety compliance. Daily tasks include troubleshooting technical issues with equipment, supporting plant operators, and implementing process control strategies to reduce downtime and improve efficiency. The position requires analyzing process data, identifying improvement opportunities, and assisting in designing or modifying process workflows to enhance throughput and resource utilization. The Specialist/Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, prepare technical documentation and reports, and support continuous improvement and sustainability initiatives within the plant.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Process Engineering and Process Design, with the ability to develop, review, and optimize manufacturing and recycling processes.
* Candidates should possess skills in Process Control and Analytical Skills, including monitoring key parameters, interpreting data, and implementing corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess knowledge in Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, with understanding of polymer, plastics, or packaging processes.
* Relevant skills in equipment troubleshooting, lean manufacturing or continuous improvement, and basic project management are beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, packaging, or recycling environments, along with familiarity with safety and environmental regulations, is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills, ability to work collaboratively on-site, and a structured, detail-oriented approach to problem-solving are expected.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**

The company specializes in tailored digital marketing strategies that align with each client’s unique goals and growth plans. By combining cutting-edge technology with data-driven insights, Digital Wolf designs campaigns that maximize performance and return on investment. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize paid digital campaigns across channels such as search, social, and display to drive measurable business outcomes. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing ad platforms, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing key metrics, and implementing A/B tests to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine targeting, messaging, and landing pages, while preparing performance reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. The Performance Marketer will also stay updated on industry trends and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Campaign Strategy and Planning**

* Understand client/business objectives, target audience, offerings, funnel and conversion goals.
* Develop performance marketing strategies based on business objectives and available budgets.
* Plan campaign structures, audience strategy, creatives, messaging, placements and budgets.
* Define relevant KPIs and benchmarks before campaign launch.
* Develop full-funnel strategies across awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing, wherever relevant.

**2.**
**Campaign Execution**

* Independently set up, launch and manage campaigns across
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Manage campaign objectives, targeting, placements, budgets, bidding, ad sets/ad groups and creatives.
* Set up and monitor conversion events, pixels/tags and other relevant tracking requirements.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure campaigns have the right assets and messaging.
* Conduct campaign launches, checks and troubleshooting independently.

**3. Campaign Optimization**

* Monitor campaigns regularly and identify performance trends, anomalies and opportunities.
* Optimize campaigns based on
  **CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate and other relevant metrics**
  .
* Conduct audience, creative, placement, budget and bidding optimization.
* Run structured A/B tests and document learnings.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action instead of simply increasing or decreasing budgets.
* Scale campaigns when performance and business economics support it.

**4. Tracking & Analytics**

* Understand campaign tracking, conversion tracking and attribution fundamentals.
* Work with tools such as
  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/Events Manager and UTM tracking**
  .
* Analyse user journeys and conversion funnels to identify drop-offs.
* Ensure campaign data is reliable before drawing performance conclusions.

**5. Reporting & Insights**

* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Go beyond reporting numbers to explain
  **why performance changed and what should be done next**
  .
* Present campaign performance, key learnings, challenges and optimization recommendations to internal teams and clients.
* Connect advertising metrics with actual business outcomes such as qualified leads, sales, revenue and customer acquisition cost.

**6. Client & Team Collaboration**

* Communicate campaign strategy, performance and recommendations clearly to clients.
* Understand client requirements and proactively identify opportunities or concerns.
* Coordinate with social media, creative, content and design teams for campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple campaigns/accounts while maintaining timelines and performance standards.
* Take ownership of assigned accounts with minimal supervision.

**Required Skills**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Meta Ads Manager**
  .
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Google Ads**
  .
* Experience managing campaigns from
  **planning to reporting**
  .
* Strong understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns.
* Good understanding of campaign tracking and attribution.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data and derive actionable insights.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts/campaigns simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels and customer journeys.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with
  **Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio**
  .
* Experience with CRM integration and lead-quality tracking.
* Experience with lead-generation businesses such as
  **education, real estate, healthcare, B2B or services**
  .
* Experience with remarketing and full-funnel campaigns.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency environment.

* Prior experience in warehouse or logistics operations preferred; high school diploma or equivalent beneficial.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery, Alcohol or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

title: Regional Aftermarket Manager(Kolkata)
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Regional AM Manager leads customer support for injection moulding machines in the domestic market. The role is responsible for maintaining machine performance and uptime, delivering end-to-end customer support, strengthening customer relationships, and generating aftermarket business to achieve assigned service and sales revenue targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Support & Service Delivery**

* Lead the Customer Support Team for injection moulding machines in the domestic market.
* Provide end-to-end customer support covering machine installation, breakdown calls, technical troubleshooting, spare-parts support, operator training and processing-related issues.
* Ensure timely customer communication for machine installation activities and site-readiness requirements.
* Support customers with mould trials, both in-house and at customer sites, to enable machine shipment and successful commissioning.
* Visit customers regularly to maintain strong liaison, address service needs and support repeat business.

**Revenue, Collections & Aftermarket Growth**

* Plan and achieve territorial service revenue and aftermarket sales revenue targets in the domestic market.
* Generate aftermarket business through service opportunities, spare-parts requirements and customer support interventions.
* Coordinate and follow up for collection of outstanding payments related to spare parts.
* Identify customer requirements and service opportunities that can strengthen long-term aftermarket revenue.

**Technical Improvement & Product Feedback**

* Gather structured information on product performance and recurring machine issues.
* Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions for machine-related concerns, and support deployment of actions across applicable machines.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve recurring issues in existing machines and provide recommendations for modifications or customisation.
* Visit mould vendors as required for validation activities.

**Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Conduct competitor analysis and share relevant insights to support future business and service strategy.
* Manage key international customers for product troubleshooting or support requirements, where assigned.
* Collaborate with service, sales, engineering, manufacturing and other internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare service data, management information reports and required operational records.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry in the ERP system.
* Maintain visibility of customer issues, corrective actions, revenue opportunities and pending follow-ups.

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**

**Service & Technical Delivery**

* Service revenue vs. target

* Closure of corrective / preventive actions
* Customer issue resolution and escalation closure
* Accuracy and timeliness of ERP / MIS data

* Customer visit and coverage discipline
* Cross-functional action closure

**Skill Dimension**

* Strong knowledge of injection moulding machines, installation, troubleshooting and breakdown support
* Understanding of mould trials, processing issues, preventive actions and spare-parts support
* Ability to translate recurring field issues into practical technical improvement actions

**Commercial & Customer**
