title: Strategy Associate- Clinical
description:
Strategy Associate – Clinical Services,

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: Minimum 5 years

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation

● Identify gaps in organisational and programme systems and support the development of

appropriate structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, indicators, and accountability

mechanisms.

● Map and evaluate programme workflows, participant journeys, research processes,

training pathways, and service-delivery mechanisms.

● Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of established processes across relevant

departments.

● Evaluate the implementation of evidence-based practices and staff development

initiatives, where applicable.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management

● Monitor risks relating to programme implementation, service quality, documentation,

research milestones, staff capacity, resource constraints, and delivery timelines.

● Maintain relevant risk registers and track mitigation plans in collaboration with

accountable teams.

● Identify emerging risks, recurring quality concerns, and deviations from established

standards.

● Escalate material concerns to the leadership and monitor agreed mitigation actions

through closure.

● Respect confidentiality, ethical research requirements, and responsible handling of

participant and organisational data.

5. Research, Data Analysis & Leadership Reporting

● Consolidate quantitative and qualitative data from relevant departments and assess its

completeness, consistency, and usefulness for decision-making.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

departmental and organisation-wide reviews.

● Translate findings into clear insights and practical recommendations for leadership.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

● Understanding of confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance

**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. * Providing extensive range of accounting and reporting services in addition to enhancing the overall value on financial reporting, technical and operational excellence related services delivered to the client.

and assets, including intangible asset; real and personal property; and various complex securities, including fixed-income securities, equities, derivatives, etc., using different valuation techniques models in accordance with US GAAP. * Apply a general knowledge of the technologies used to build complex IT environments and facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services

The role will support clients in making informed decisions on airport development, expansion, investment, commercialization, privatization, airport city development, and long-term aviation growth strategies.

**Client Engagement & Business Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with key aviation stakeholders.
* Support proposal preparation, pursuits, and client presentations.

with specialized expertise in Payment Factory, Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing, and In-House Bank (IHB) solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Central Finance solutions within SAP S/4HANA environments. * Implement and manage Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) processing and automated bank statement ingestion.
* Configure Bank Account Management (BAM), cash positioning, payment processing, and treasury integration.
* Partner with banking partners and middleware teams to establish secure, scalable bank interfaces.

Data Replication & Error Handling
  
  

* Manage continuous financial transaction replication, mapping rules, and system reconciliations between source systems and target CFIN environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and resolve replication errors using SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF).

Stakeholder Management & Project Lifecycle
  
  

* Gather and translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, configuration documents, and process flow diagrams.

* Banking Solutions: Demonstrated expertise in EBS ingestion, Central Payment, and In-House Bank (IHB) configuration.
* S/4HANA: Direct hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance projects.

Technical & Functional Core Competencies
  
  

* Deep functional understanding of SAP FI (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management).
* Technical proficiency in AIF monitoring, error resolution, object mapping, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of financial data replication architectures across multi-ERP landscapes.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations in high-visibility enterprise initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance certification.
* Exposure to SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) or Advanced Payment Management (APM).
* Experience with multi-national, multi-currency implementations and complex banking formats (e.g., ISO 20022, MT940, BAI2).

title: Store Manager
description:
About the role

The Store Supervisor is responsible for managing the factory store operations, ensuring timely

receipt, proper storage, accurate tracking, and issue of materials required for production. The role

ensures uninterrupted production by maintaining optimal inventory levels and enforcing proper

storage and material handling systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Material Receipt & Inspection**

* Receive incoming materials from suppliers as per purchase orders.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control department for inspection approval.
* Ensure proper documentation of Goods Receipt Notes (GRN).
* Report discrepancies, damages, or shortages to the Purchase department.

**Storage & Preservation**

* Ensure materials are stored in designated locations as per storage guidelines.
* Maintain proper labelling, binning, and identification of all items.
* Follow FIFO principles where applicable.
* Ensure safe handling and storage conditions to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration.
* Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of the store area.

**Material Issue to Production**

* Issue materials to production lines as per approved requisitions.
* Ensure timely supply of materials to avoid production delays.
* Maintain proper records of all issued materials.
* Coordinate with production supervisors regarding material requirements.

**Inventory Management & Tracking**

* Maintain accurate stock records (Bin card, ERP system).
* Monitor stock levels and inform Purchase for reorder planning.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and cycle counting.
* Investigate and report stock variances.
* Ensure proper tracking of fast-moving and slow-moving items.

**Store System & Compliance**

* Maintain updated documentation of all store transactions.
* Implement proper storage systems and improve layout efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and factory standards.
* Support internal and external audits.

**Team Supervision**

* Supervise storekeepers and store assistants.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of inventory management systems.
* Understanding of warehouse/store operations in manufacturing.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Tally, Oracle, etc.) preferred.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of safety standards and material handling.
* Problem-solving and organizational skills.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or related field (preferred).
* Relevant experience in factory or manufacturing store operations.

**Experience**

* 10 -15 years of experience in factory store/warehouse operations.
* Prior supervisory experience preferred.

**Company Description**
VISION RX LAB is one of the largest ophthalmic prescription lens manufacturers in Asia, offering comprehensive lens solutions from traditional to advanced digital Rx, coatings, tinting, glazing, and mounting. A 100% subsidiary of EssilorLuxottica, the company has been producing high-quality organic and mineral lenses for around 65 years. description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

description:
**Company Description**
Clubside Tours and Travels Pvt Ltd is a leading Destination Management Company with its registered office in Kolkata and branch offices in Darjeeling, Siliguri, Guwahati, Andaman, and Bhutan. The company specializes in crafting travel experiences across West Bengal, Sikkim, Bhutan, Andaman, and the Northeast, focusing on both natural beauty and cultural immersion. Services include cultural and wildlife tours, special interest itineraries, and adventure activities such as trekking, rafting, and riverside camping. With deep regional expertise, Clubside has become one of the largest tour operators in the area and is recognized with multiple National Tourism Awards and FICCI Travel and Excellence Awards for its domestic and adventure tour operations.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Travel Consultant role based in Kolkata. The Travel Consultant will design and customize itineraries, handle travel inquiries, and advise clients on destinations, accommodations, and transport options across the regions where Clubside operates. Daily responsibilities include managing bookings and reservations, preparing quotations, coordinating travel arrangements with vendors, and ensuring accurate documentation and confirmations. The role involves delivering responsive customer service, resolving travel-related issues, and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of regional attractions, regulations, and seasonal trends. The Travel Consultant will collaborate with internal teams to optimize tour packages and support the overall quality of client experiences.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Consulting and client advisory related to destinations, routes, and itineraries.
* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Management, including planning, coordination, and oversight of tour operations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Travel Arrangements, covering transport, accommodation, activities, and vendor coordination.
* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, problem-solving, and client satisfaction.
* Candidates should possess skills in managing Reservations and booking systems with attention to accuracy and timelines.
* Good communication skills in English and regional languages, along with clear written and verbal interaction with clients and partners.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple inquiries, and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Prior experience in the travel or tourism industry, especially in domestic or adventure travel, is preferred.
* Proficiency with basic office software and online booking tools; familiarity with CRM or travel management systems is an advantage.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field is beneficial.

title: SAP TM-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Advisory – SAP TM Functional Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Look For**
**What we offer you**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI**
**Role Overview**
Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary
**AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect**
, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a
**Developer Advocate**
and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.
  
  
This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.
  
  
As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization**

* Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.
* Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.
* Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.
* Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).
* Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.
* Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

**Data & AI Infrastructure**

* Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.
* Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.
* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

**Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture**

* Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.
* Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.
* Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

**GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy**

* You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.
* You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.
* Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

**Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership**

* Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.
* Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.
* Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.
* Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.
* Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.
* System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.
* Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.
* Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.
* Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.
* Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.
* Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).
* Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.
* Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.
* Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.
* Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

**Why Join Us?**

* Impact at scale—we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges.
* Modern technical foundation with room to innovate—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Hands-on architecture leadership—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.
* Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts, pushing the limits of what’s possible.
* Competitive compensation and high ownership—your work will define how Jumio scales.

**Jumio Values:**
IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
**:**
Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.
  
  
**About Jumio:**
Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.
  
  
Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.
  
  
**Applicant Data Privacy**
We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

description:

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. * AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
* Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication.
* System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective.
* Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience designing and building GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.
* Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees).

**Eligibility Criteria**

description:

For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.

* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.

* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.

* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.

* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.

title: Taxi Driver
description:
**Company Description**
P.Z. International operates passenger transportation services with a focus on reliable, safe, and customer-friendly taxi operations. The company aims to provide timely point-to-point travel for individuals, families, and business travelers across Kolkata and surrounding areas. P.Z. International emphasizes professional conduct, vehicle cleanliness, and adherence to local traffic and safety regulations. Team members are supported with clear procedures and guidelines to help them deliver consistent, high-quality service.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Taxi Driver role based in Kolkata. The Taxi Driver will transport passengers safely and efficiently to their destinations, following traffic rules and company guidelines. Daily tasks include accepting ride requests, planning routes, operating the vehicle in various traffic and weather conditions, and assisting passengers with boarding and luggage as needed. The role involves handling payments, providing clear information about fares, and maintaining a courteous, professional demeanor with all passengers. The Taxi Driver is also responsible for keeping the vehicle clean, reporting any mechanical issues, and coordinating with the company team regarding schedules and service requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Automotive: Strong driving skills, valid driver’s license, and familiarity with local traffic regulations and road networks.
* Training: Willingness to participate in company-provided training on safety, customer service, and operational procedures.
* Sales: Ability to promote company services through professional conduct and positive passenger interactions.
* Additional skills: Good communication skills, basic numeracy for handling fares, and the ability to work flexibly across shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Beneficial qualifications: Prior experience in taxi or commercial driving, knowledge of basic vehicle maintenance, and the ability to use GPS or navigation applications.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about scaling Cloud services to join our growing SRE team. The SRE team owns the infrastructure, tooling and automation that Jira and Confluence Cloud runs on, and has a deep understanding of how Atlassian products leverage cloud infrastructure to meet customer reliability expectations.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a technical leader who is aware of current industry trends (particularly those related to reliability). You have experience mentoring and growing team members and love to share your knowledge with others. We'd love it if you brought a deep understanding of modern Cloud infrastructure, programming expertise, operational experience and a desire to change the status quo. We're looking for an engineer who can analyse and help improve our services and processes to get us to an even higher level of reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will report directly to the Senior Engineering Manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* 5+ years experience operating high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production: building monitoring, tweaking dashboards, defining alerts, writing runbooks, etc.
* 5+ years of hands on experience with public cloud offerings (at least 1 year experience on GCP).
* Familiarity with Unix / Linux operating systems.
* Strong emphasis to debug, improve code, and automate routine tasks.
* Strong backend engineering experience in one or more prominent languages such as Java, Go or Python.
* Excellent communication skills in written and verbal forms, and an ability to communicate complex technical issues to a range of technical and non-technical audiences (management, peers, clients).
* An ability and desire to mentor and coach engineers

**Qualifications**
**It would be great, but not mandatory if you had:**

* Experience in datastores (RDBMS, time-series-database, NoSql, search, analytics).
* Experience in microservice architecture.
* Experience building web-services and clients using REST/GraphQL.
* Expertise in JVM, Garbage Collection, and Performance Tuning.

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Application Support Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**

15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As an Application Support Engineer, a typical day involves acting as a software detective by proactively monitoring and diagnosing issues across various components of essential business systems. This role requires a dynamic approach to identifying challenges and delivering timely solutions to ensure smooth system operations. Collaboration with different teams and continuous investigation into system behavior are key aspects of the daily routine, contributing to maintaining the reliability and efficiency of critical business applications.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information and resolve complex system issues.
* Document findings and solutions to build a knowledge base for future reference.
* Assist junior team members by sharing insights and providing guidance on troubleshooting techniques.
* Continuously monitor system performance and recommend improvements to enhance stability and user experience.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics.
* Strong analytical skills to investigate and resolve software issues effectively.
* Experience with system monitoring tools and diagnostic techniques.
* Ability to interpret system logs and trace errors to their root cause.
* Good communication skills to articulate technical information clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Familiarity with business process workflows and their impact on system performance.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics.
* This position is based at our KDC1A - SEZ location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Head of Brand & Business | D2C Functional Beverages
description:
Head of Brand & Business | D2C Functional Beverages

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
Ideally 2–5 years

About the Role

We’re building a new magnesium drink brand focused on relaxation, unwinding and everyday wellbeing.

We’re looking for an experienced leader who has
**built a consumer brand from scratch**
, ideally within beverages, nutrition, supplements or wellness.

Working directly with the founders, you will take the brand from product development through launch and own its growth as a D2C business. This is a hands-on role spanning brand strategy, ecommerce, marketing, product launch and commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Define the brand’s positioning, target audience, messaging, pricing and customer experience.
* Work with formulation, manufacturing, packaging and compliance partners to prepare the product for launch.
* Build and execute the launch strategy across ecommerce, social media, influencers, sampling and partnerships.
* Own the D2C website, customer acquisition, conversion, retention and repeat purchases.
* Manage marketing budgets and track acquisition costs, average order value and contribution margins.
* Develop content, creator partnerships and community initiatives that drive awareness and trial.
* Build and manage a lean team of employees, agencies and specialist partners.
* Use customer feedback and purchase behaviour to improve the product and brand experience.
* Evaluate opportunities across marketplaces, quick commerce and selective offline channels.

What We’re Looking For

* Proven experience launching and scaling a D2C consumer brand, with meaningful ownership from an early stage.
* Ideally 6–10 years of relevant experience in consumer brands.
* Experience in beverages, food, nutrition, supplements or wellness is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of brand building, ecommerce, performance marketing and retention.
* Commercial judgement and experience managing budgets and unit economics.
* Ability to move between strategy and daily execution.
* Comfortable working closely with founders in a small, early-stage team.

**Previous founders and early team members who have helped build consumer brands are encouraged to apply.**

How to Apply

Please share your CV and a brief note outlining:

* The brands you have helped build and the stage at which you joined.
* What you personally owned across launch and growth.
* The measurable results you delivered.

title: Freelance Writer
description:
**Company Description**
SD Dey is an independent professional writer and content creator based in Kolkata, collaborating with content creators, youtube channels and small businesses on a variety of writing projects. The work spans blogs, articles, and creative pieces, often tailored to specific audiences and platforms. Assignments may involve both short-form and long-form content, allowing room for skill development and experimentation with different writing styles. * Current students or recent graduates in fields such as English, Journalism, Communications, or related disciplines are encouraged to apply.

title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Why join Safeguard Global?**
👀
  
  
We want to help you
**“work in any way**
” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀
  
  
Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first — they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a
**job that works for you. ✅**
**The role in a nutshell:**
We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to support the management and ongoing optimization of Safeguard Global’s Salesforce Service Cloud platform. Reporting to the Senior Salesforce Administrator, this role will help maintain the day-to-day operations of Service Cloud, support system enhancements, and assist with user requests and troubleshooting. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with support and operations teams to translate business needs into platform configurations, automation, and reporting capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. While the primary focus of this role is Service Cloud, the administrator should maintain a general awareness of Sales Cloud functionality to ensure alignment across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will also support the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, helping implement automation and intelligent service workflows that enhance support operations and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**How you will make a difference:**

* Support the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, and performance.
* Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to implement system enhancements and platform improvements.
* Configure and maintain Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automation flows.
* Assist with user management, including account setup, permissions, and role-based access controls.
* Provide frontline support for Salesforce users by troubleshooting issues and responding to support requests.
* Collaborate with operations and support teams to gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with maintaining data quality and integrity through monitoring, data cleanup, and governance practices.
* Support testing, validation, and deployment of Salesforce updates and new features.
* Assist with the configuration and monitoring of AI-powered capabilities such as Agentforce agents and service automation workflows.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations that enable reliable data exchange and workflow synchronization between Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Workday, and other business platforms
* Document system configurations, processes, and user guides to support internal knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to ensure alignment across the Salesforce platform.

**What will give you an advantage:**

* 3+ years of experience working with Salesforce
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201) preferred
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of day to day workings in AWS Telephony platform for inbound and outbound contact handling
* Working knowledge of MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication, data mapping, and flow monitoring to support integrations between Salesforce Service Cloud and platforms such as Jira and Workday
* Basic familiarity with Sales Cloud concepts and objects to maintain cross-platform awareness.
* Experience configuring Salesforce features such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Exposure to Salesforce Flow or automation tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce or Einstein AI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical configurations
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

**Who we are and what we do:**
  
  
Safeguard Global is…global!
**We enable global expansion without the risk**
by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎
  
  
**Our Global Benefits**
:
  
  

* 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
* 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family
* 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
* 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
* ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
* ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
* 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.

  
  
**Next Steps:**
  
  
To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.
  
  
**Welcome to the Future of Work!**
🌐
  
  
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

Customer is looking for experienced actuarial profiles in the ongoing Illustration Modernization initiative. The resources would analyze the existing actuarial calculation processes and part of the modernization programs. This role is for an experienced consultant with deep expertise in insurance quoting and insurance products responsible for advising business and technology stakeholders on optimized solutions that enhance quoting accuracy streamline product configuration

candidate must have -
  
  

* Actuarial skills having around 10+ years of experience.

* Experience on new business and/or Illustrations .
* Lead end to end consulting engagements in the insurance domain by analyzing business objectives and translating them into robust quoting and product configuration solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

* Provide comprehensive guidance on insurance product structures rating logic underwriting rules and policy lifecycle processes to ensure that solution designs align with regulatory obligations and market expectations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and technical teams in a hybrid work model to elicit requirements validate solution options and ensure that insurance quoting and product changes are fully understood and correctly implemented.
* Develop clear functional specifications and process maps for new or enhanced insurance products and quoting capabilities enabling implementation teams to configure systems consistently and maintain data integrity.
* Oversee configuration and testing of insurance quoting functionalities in core platforms by defining test scenarios reviewing results and ensuring that defect resolution supports high quality releases in day shift operations.
* Guide the adoption of best practices in pricing discounting and underwriting decision support within quoting workflows so that front line users can generate compliant and competitive quotes with minimal rework.
* Coordinate impact analysis for proposed changes to insurance products and quoting rules explaining downstream effects on policy administration billing and reporting so that all dependent processes remain stable and predictable.
* Provide analytical insights using key performance metrics such as quote conversion turnaround time and loss ratio and recommend data driven improvements that support the organizations strategic growth and customer centric goals.
* Support business case development for new insurance product initiatives by estimating benefits resource needs and implementation timelines to help decision makers prioritize investments that deliver societal value through improved protection offerings.
* Mentor junior consultants and analysts in the insurance domain by sharing practical knowledge on quoting standards product design and stakeholder communication thereby strengthening overall team capability and delivery consistency.
* Engage proactively with operations and customer service teams to understand pain points in daily quoting and product usage then convert these insights into actionable enhancements that reduce manual work and improve service quality.
* Ensure that all consulting activities adhere to compliance policies data privacy expectations and regulatory requirements for insurance products so that solutions protect customers interests and uphold the organizations reputation.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience in insurance quoting to design and refine rating structures eligibility criteria and risk assessment approaches that support accurate premium calculations and transparent customer communication.
* Utilize deep expertise in insurance products across lines of business to shape coverage options endorsements and product variants that respond to evolving customer needs and market trends.
* Leverage nine to thirteen years of professional consulting or insurance industry experience to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and deliver solutions that balance business agility with operational stability.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in analyzing process flows and system behavior in hybrid working environments enabling effective collaboration across on site and remote teams without requiring travel.
* Use advanced problem solving and communication skills to translate technical details about insurance quoting and product configuration into clear guidance for nontechnical stakeholders and decision makers.
* Apply familiarity with day shift operational constraints to propose implementation and rollout plans that minimize business disruption while ensuring thorough training and adoption for end users.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include insurance domain credential such as Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter or equivalent industry recognized insurance qualification.

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength.
