Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Customer Manager**
, based in
**Kolkata, India**
, you will be a dynamic and self-motivated commercial professional who combines strategic thinking with disciplined execution to drive profitable growth. In this role, you will lead the
**Building & Infrastructure**
business across
**Eastern India and Bangladesh**
, with responsibility for key market segments including
**Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other strategic growth areas**
.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies, identifying and converting new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and expanding Dow’s route-to-market network. This includes working closely with distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other key industry stakeholders. You will be equally effective in engaging customers at the point of sale, influencing project stakeholders, and presenting market insights, business strategies, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to combine customer insights, channel development expertise, project specification influence, value-based selling, and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate market penetration and drive sustainable business growth. Your ability to translate market trends and customer needs into actionable commercial strategies will be instrumental in strengthening Dow’s market position and delivering long-term business success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth strategies for the Building & Infrastructure business across Eastern India and Bangladesh, with a strong focus on Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated market segments.
* Expand and strengthen the retail route-to-market by developing high-performing networks of distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other channel partners to maximize market reach and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other key decision-makers to influence specifications and secure project opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities while maintaining a robust sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management from inception through closure.
* Drive value-based selling initiatives, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, and joint business plans that contribute to revenue growth, margin expansion, customer retention, and channel excellence.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Service, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to deliver customer value while providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and business updates to senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should possess:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Business, or a related field from a recognized institution. An MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, project sales, channel development, market development, or related commercial roles.
* Proven experience serving customers within the Building & Infrastructure, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, Architectural Solutions, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in developing and growing markets through distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and similar channel partners across geographically diverse regions.
* Experience managing strategic accounts, major projects, and specification-driven opportunities while influencing a broad range of stakeholders involved in purchasing decisions.
* A proven track record of independently developing markets, converting opportunities into sustainable business growth, and presenting business strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Eastern India and Bangladesh.

**Your Skills**

* Market development and growth strategy, with the ability to transform customer, channel, and competitive insights into executable business plans.
* Channel and retail development, including distributor management, dealer expansion, outlet penetration, and demand generation.
* Strategic account and project management, including stakeholder mapping, specification influence, and opportunity conversion.
* Value-based selling, commercial negotiations, and development of differentiated solutions that create customer value.
* Business planning and commercial analytics, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance tracking, and corrective action planning.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively present business strategies, market intelligence, and growth recommendations.

**Additional Notes**

* This position supports market development activities across Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* The business portfolio includes Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated Building & Infrastructure market segments.
* Extensive travel is required to develop customer relationships, strengthen channel networks, support project opportunities, and identify new areas for business growth.
* Relocation support is not available for this position.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation
* Team Management experience (For Senior Professionals)
* MBA or Chartered Accountant with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Audit

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (Bangalore,Kolkata,Ahmedabad)
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Understanding the project, Client requirements, Schedule and Budgets.
* Oversee the integration of Mechanical design with other discipline. Lead the team ensuring timely and accurate production of deliverables.
* Collaborate with global multi-disciplinary teams, acting as the focal point for MEP design interfaces.
* Review and check reports, drawings, and calculations for technical soundness, coordination, and compliance.
* Ensure MEP deliverables adhere to SYSTRA policies, quality management systems, safety practices, design and project processes and ISO certifications

* Identify and resolve technical issues or design conflicts that arise during the design and construction phases.
* Through the lifecycle of a design project, you will liaise with specialist engineering teams to ensure that the design work is delivered in accordance with the engineering best practice and in compliance with mandated standards.
* Proactively working to contribute to a continuous improvement culture raising opportunities for improvement whenever these are identified.
* Act as primary interface between Mechanical disciplines with various other discipline including architects, civil / structural Engineers, Contractors and consultants to track and resolve interface conflicts and ensure efficient workflows.
* Act as the main point of contact for design queries, change management, and technical issue resolution within project teams.
* Liaise with project managers, Engineers, civil and systems engineers, and clients to understand and deliver project requirements.
* Collaborate with project management team to develop detailed schedules, monitor progress, manage design costs. Support project scheduling, resource allocation, and milestone deliverables for Mechanical design scope.
* Participate in site visits, technical meetings, and support project handover phases. Ensure installations and commissioning.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.
* Minimum 8 years' relevant experience in MEP design and coordination for large scale metro rail / infrastructure projects
* Professional certification (CEng/PE or equivalent) preferred.
* Track record of successful MEP design delivery on international projects (UK, Europe, Middle East preferred).
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Ability to work within a culturally diverse organization, recognizing and respecting differences.
* Ability to problem solve, especially in an integrated project delivery environment, applying industry best practices.
* Self-motivated individual with outstanding leadership skills and the ability to influence without authority

* Proficient in Carier HAP, IES, McQuay Duct/Pipe Sizer, Heva comp etc

On-site

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Company: AniGears Engineering Solutions

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Experience: Minimum 10 years

Salary: ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month

About the Role

AniGears is seeking a highly experienced, energetic and technically sound Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead engineering activities across business development, reverse engineering, production coordination and mechanical equipment development.

The candidate will be the senior-most member of the engineering team and will be responsible for taking ownership of projects from customer enquiry and technical discussions through design, production and final delivery. The role requires strong practical knowledge, independent decision-making and the ability to manage both field and production responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Sales & Business Development

• Visit industrial clients and conduct technical and commercial meetings.

• Understand customer requirements, develop technical solutions, negotiate and close deals.

• Generate new business and maintain strong client relationships.

• Handle enquiries for mechanical components, power transmission products and complete mechanical assemblies and equipment.

2. Reverse Engineering & Design

• Conduct site visits and take accurate measurements of components and assemblies.

• Prepare mechanical sketches, dimensional drawings and CAD drawings.

• Handle reverse engineering and product development for components as well as mechanical equipment, including roller assemblies.

• Possess working knowledge of industrial couplings, Cardan shafts, sprockets, pulleys and other power transmission products.

3. Production & Engineering Operations

• Coordinate with vendors, workshops and production teams to ensure timely order execution.

• Understand machining, fabrication, fitting, assembly, inspection and other relevant manufacturing processes.

• Ensure production adheres to technical drawings, specifications, quality requirements and delivery schedules.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and take prompt corrective decisions.

• Be prepared to transition between field engineering and production operations as AniGears develops its own manufacturing capabilities.

4. Team Leadership & Project Management

• Assign tasks to junior engineers and monitor their progress and output.

• Review drawings, technical work and project execution.

• Coordinate engineering, procurement, vendors and production to ensure timely completion of orders.

• Take ownership of projects from initial enquiry to final dispatch.

• Make independent decisions and remain accountable for technical, commercial and operational outcomes.

Candidate Requirements

• B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in industrial mechanical engineering, power transmission products, machinery or mechanical assemblies.

• Strong practical knowledge of mechanical components, their construction, applications and working principles.

• Proficiency in mechanical measurements, technical sketching, engineering drawings and CAD software.

• Good understanding of manufacturing and production processes.

• Experience in technical sales, client handling, commercial discussions and team management.

• Energetic, proactive, decisive and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Important: We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer who can contribute from day one. Candidates must already understand industrial mechanical products and engineering practices. Basic product training will not be provided.

Compensation

₹30,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and capability.

title: Co-Founder with Investment
description:
# Seeking Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner | ₹10 Lakhs+ Investment | Healthcare, Education & Technology
  
  
I am looking for an entrepreneurial \*\*Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner\*\* who can bring investment, sales and marketing expertise to help build and scale a healthcare-focused digital business with ambitions in India and globally.
  
  
## About Our Existing Digital Assets
  
  
We have developed multiple healthcare-focused websites and media assets that are receiving website traffic. We are now preparing to monetise these platforms and establish sustainable revenue streams.
  
  
\*\*Our current platforms include:\*\*
  
  
\*\*1. DentalClinicAlly.com — Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Helping Indian dentists with dental clinic setup consulting, business Planning, dental clinic growth strategies & Dentist Brand development.
  
  
\*\*2. DentistUpgrade.com — Dental Education & Government Job information - Career Platform\*\*
  
  
Our vision is to develop DentistUpgrade.com into a \*\*global training platform for dentists\*\*, offering:
  
  
\* Hands-on clinical training programmes.
  
\* Online courses for dentists.
  
\* Continuing professional learning opportunities.
  
\* Educational resources to help dentists enhance their clinical knowledge and professional skills.
  
\* Government Dental job listings and career-related opportunities.
  
  
\*\*3. Medihel365.com — Healthcare Digital Platform, Health care services provide Directory\*\*
  
  
An additional digital asset with potential to serve broader healthcare audiences as our business develops.
  
  
\*\*4. Chikitsa Katha & Medical Help 365days\*\*
  
  
Our medical-related YouTube channels, providing opportunities to develop healthcare education content and explore future monetisation.
  
  
## Our Long-Term Business Vision
  
  
We plan to build a broader healthcare services, education and technology business through four major areas:
  
  
\*\*1. Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Help dentists establish, manage and grow their clinics through practical business consultancy and customised growth planning.
  
  
\*\*2. Global Dental Training & Education\*\*
  
  
Build DentistUpgrade.com into a global platform offering hands-on training, online courses and professional learning opportunities for dentists.
  
  
\*\*3. Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency\*\*
  
  
Provide specialised digital marketing, lead generation and patient acquisition services to dentists, clinics and other healthcare service providers.
  
  
\*\*4. Patient & Clinic Management Software\*\*
  
  
Explore the development of software to support clinic operations, patient management, appointment workflows and practice administration.
  
  
Our initial focus will be on dentists, with plans to expand into other healthcare services as we validate demand and build our capabilities.
  
  
## Who Are We Looking For?
  
  
I am seeking a strategic partner who can contribute both capital and practical business-building expertise.
  
  
\*\*Key requirements:\*\*
  
  
\* Minimum proposed investment of \*\*₹10 lakhs\*\*.
  
\* Strong experience in sales, marketing, business development or entrepreneurship.
  
\* Ability to develop customer acquisition strategies and generate paying customers.
  
\* Experience in healthcare, dental education, digital marketing, EdTech, SaaS or HealthTech will be an advantage.
  
\* Ability to develop strategic partnerships with dentists, training providers, clinics and healthcare organisations.
  
\* A long-term vision for building a scalable healthcare business in India and internationally.
  
  
## Role & Responsibilities
  
  
The selected partner will work with me to:
  
  
\* Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies.
  
\* Acquire our first paying customers and establish repeatable revenue channels.
  
\* Build partnerships for dental training, education and healthcare services.
  
\* Develop revenue models for our existing websites and digital assets.
  
\* Explore opportunities in healthcare digital marketing and clinic management software.
  
\* Help establish and scale our dental education platform for a global audience.
  
  
## What We Bring
  
  
I bring \*\*12+ years of dental experience and experience owning two dental clinics\*\*, along with existing websites, digital platforms and healthcare-related media assets.
  
  
We have a foundation to build upon, and our current priority is to convert existing website traffic into paying customers, validate our business models and develop our future services progressively.
  
  
\*\*Please note:\*\* We are currently at an early stage of monetisation and are not yet generating revenue from these ventures. Our future initiatives will depend on market validation, investment and execution.
  
  
## Interested in Building This Business Together?
  
  
If you have the investment capacity, relevant experience and entrepreneurial mindset, I would welcome a discussion.
  
  
Please message me on LinkedIn with:
  
  
1. Your professional background and entrepreneurial experience.
  
2. Your sales, marketing, education or technology expertise.
  
3. Your proposed role and contribution.
  
4. Your investment capacity and expectations.
  
  
This is a \*\*co-founder and strategic investment partnership opportunity, not a salaried job\*\*. Equity participation, investment terms, responsibilities and governance will be discussed transparently and documented through appropriate legal agreements. Investment does not guarantee returns.
  
  
Let's explore the opportunity to build a healthcare, dental education and technology business with global ambitions.
  
  
#CoFounder #StrategicPartner #DentalEducation #HealthcareBusiness #HealthTech #EdTech #DigitalHealth #StartupIndia #DentalTraining #Entrepreneurship

title: Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the Role**

The corporate ecosystem needs tailored solutions to solve financial needs in a globally knit business environment. As an Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking Group, you will have the opportunity to manage the global trade finance, cash management (including payments and receivables), and banking needs of corporate clients. In addition, the role encompasses servicing client requirements across the financial spectrum. Hence, it is imperative that you analyze the available data to understand the client persona and subsequently offer the right solutions as part of the 360-degree banking framework. Leveraging technological platforms is at the core of providing clients a best-in-class experience. The role involves enhancing the relationship value with existing customers and onboarding new customers through lead generation from customers, vendors, dealers, and curated databases.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Increase relationship value:**
Managing Transaction Banking relationships of corporate clients with the aim to increase relationship value with impeccable focus on quality of service.

**Market understanding:**
Scoping the market for opportunities and understanding the competition, industry, and economy.

**Building relationships:**
Sourcing of new corporate relationships linked to existing relationships by offering the right solutions through the customer 360-degree approach.

**Collaboration:**
Ability to collaborate with multiple internal groups to provide efficient and innovative financial products to the mapped clients.

**Customer service:**
Facilitate day-to-day corporate needs and understand the intricacies of the products and services to ensure a seamless banking experience for the clients.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA, Chartered Accountants, Engineers & Graduates with relevant work experience in Trade Finance or Lending.

**Market Understanding:**
Ability to understand market dynamics, both at micro and macro levels.

**Communication Skill:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with the distribution team for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Interpersonal Skills:**
Build & maintain strong professional relationships with the customers.

**Domain Knowledge:**
Knowledge on finance, forex, and trade.

**About the Business Group**

The Transaction Banking Group at ICICI Bank services corporate clients across the country for their Cash Management and Trade Finance requirements. The group aims to service the requirements of import and export businesses (both domestic and cross-border) under Trade Finance and payments & collections under Cash Management. Transaction Banking is deeply interlinked with clients across Large Corporate Groups (LCG), Small and medium Enterprises (SME), MSMEs, Government Institutions, and PSUs. Clients are serviced by the on-ground team of Account Managers and Customer Service Managers ably supported by the Product Design team.

title: Personal Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Kolkata Fitness Zone is a dedicated fitness center focused on helping individuals achieve sustainable health and wellness goals. The facility offers a range of training programs, from general fitness to sports-specific conditioning, in a supportive and results-oriented environment. Team members work closely with clients of diverse backgrounds and fitness levels, emphasizing safe, effective, and engaging workouts. The organization values professional development, client satisfaction, and a positive, inclusive atmosphere for both staff and members.

**Role Description**
The Personal Trainer will provide one-on-one and small-group fitness instruction, designing and delivering customized workout plans based on client goals, fitness levels, and health considerations. Daily responsibilities include conducting fitness assessments, demonstrating proper exercise techniques, monitoring form and safety, and adjusting training programs as clients progress. The trainer will educate clients on healthy lifestyle habits, coordinate with other staff to support member engagement, and maintain accurate records of client sessions and progress. This is a full-time, on-site role based at Kolkata Fitness Zone in Kolkata, requiring consistent presence during assigned shifts, including possible early morning, evening, and weekend hours.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Personal Training and Fitness Instruction skills, with the ability to design and lead effective workouts for varied fitness levels.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Nutrition to guide clients on basic dietary principles that support their training and wellness goals.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Circuit Training to plan time-efficient, structured routines that improve strength, endurance, and overall conditioning.
* Candidates should possess Sports Coaching skills to support clients engaged in sport-specific performance and injury prevention training.
* Relevant certifications in personal training or fitness (e.g., recognized national or international bodies) and knowledge of exercise science or kinesiology are highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to work inclusively with clients of different ages and backgrounds.
* Ability to maintain a safe training environment, including knowledge of basic first aid, injury prevention, and gym equipment usage.
* Prior experience in a gym or fitness center setting and familiarity with client scheduling and documentation tools are considered an advantage.

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the role

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service**

Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development**

Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking**

Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality**

Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions**

As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values**

Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification**

MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team**

Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise**

Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing**

Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication**

Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

title: Outreach Lead
description:
Organization

UXFoundery is a community where designers connect, learn, and grow together. We bring professionals from diverse design disciplines into one space to exchange ideas, explore new perspectives, and build meaningful relationships.

Through events, workshops, conversations, and collaborative experiences, we're creating a platform that supports peer learning, professional development, and connections across the global design ecosystem.

We're building UXFoundery from the ground up, with a vision to connect designers across cities and countries through a strong, collaborative community.

We're looking for an enthusiastic and proactive
**Outreach Lead**
to help expand UXFoundery's community, establish partnerships, and build relationships across the design ecosystem.

This is a
**volunteer leadership opportunity**
for someone passionate about community building, networking, and creating meaningful professional connections.

As Outreach Lead, you'll take ownership of outreach initiatives, identify collaboration opportunities, connect with potential partners, and help UXFoundery grow its presence across colleges, companies, and design communities.

You'll work closely with our core team to plan outreach strategies, coordinate community initiatives, and turn conversations into meaningful collaborations.

**Candidates based in Kolkata will be preferred**

* **Community Outreach:**

* **Partnerships:**
  Build relationships with colleges, companies, organisations, and other communities.

  Identify opportunities to expand UXFoundery's reach across cities and international design communities.
* **Event Collaborations:**
  Support outreach for meetups, workshops, talks, and community events.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Maintain communication with partners, follow up on conversations, and nurture long-term relationships.
* **Research:**
  Identify relevant communities, organisations, potential collaborators, and growth opportunities.
* **Communication:**
  Help create outreach messages, partnership proposals, event announcements, and follow-up communications.
* **Ownership:**
  Take initiatives from ideation to execution while collaborating with the core team.

Qualifications

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build relationships and confidently initiate conversations.
* Interest in community building, networking, partnerships, or outreach.
* Strong organisational skills and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to research opportunities and identify potential collaborators.
* Experience in event coordination, student communities, design communities, or partnerships is a plus.
* A background in design, marketing, communications, or business is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership in an early-stage community.

Important Information

* **This is a volunteer role and is currently unpaid.**
* This opportunity is ideal for individuals who want to develop their leadership, outreach, partnership-building, and community management skills.
* You'll have the opportunity to contribute to building a growing design community and collaborate with designers and industry professionals.
* Candidates based in Kolkata will be preferred, but individuals from other locations with a strong interest in community building are welcome to express their interest.

Although this is an unpaid volunteer role, you'll be part of the UXFoundery team and enjoy the following benefits:

* **Free Event Access:**

* **Exclusive Team Swag:**
  Receive UXFoundery merchandise, swags, and goodies from the team.
* **Networking Opportunities:**
  Connect with designers, industry professionals, speakers, and community leaders.
* **Leadership Experience:**
  Build hands-on experience in outreach, partnerships, and community building.
* **Team Recognition:**
  Be part of the team shaping UXFoundery's growth and global community initiatives.

Interested?

If you're passionate about bringing people together and want to help build a community that makes a meaningful difference in the design ecosystem, we'd love to hear from you.

Send your introduction to hello@uxfoundery.com with a brief note about yourself, your relevant experience, and why you'd like to join UXFoundery.

Let's build a global design community together.

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

description:
**Job Description**
: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1
  
  
**Position:**
Microsoft 365 / O365 L1 Support Engineer
  
  
**Number of Openings:**
8 Resources

1–3 Years (Preferred)

Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Support: Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Ticket Documentation: Maintain accurate ticket updates, troubleshooting records, resolution notes, and knowledge-base articles.
* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.

title: UGC Content Creator (Remote Internship)
description:
**About Uzi World Digital**

Uzi World Digital is a digital marketing agency based in Kolkata, India. We offer web design, SEO, digital PR, social media marketing, online reputation management, branding, and digital advertising for brands, public figures, and creators.

**About the Internship**

Your first step into digital marketing can start in front of the camera. This internship gives college students the chance to become one of the faces of Uzi World Digital, creating short-form videos such as Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts that represent our work, culture, and values. It is built for students who are just starting out and want to learn how a digital agency works, with structured guidance and mentorship throughout and room to bring their own personality and ideas to the content.

**What You Will Do**

* Script, shoot, and edit short-form videos with guidance from our team. No prior editing experience is needed, training is provided, and mobile apps like CapCut are enough.
* Represent Uzi World Digital authentically on camera and through storytelling
* Develop video ideas with our marketing and creative teams, based on campaigns and trends
* Publish content on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and engage with the audience
* Learn to read basic analytics such as views, engagement, and shares to improve your content

**What You Will Get**

* Hands-on training in short-form video production, from idea to publishing
* Insight into how a digital agency handles content strategy, brand storytelling, and performance
* Mentorship from the founder and senior team members
* Real-world projects for your portfolio, across different industries
* Room to showcase your creativity and build your personal brand
* Certificate of Internship and Letter of Recommendation, based on performance and contribution
* Flexible remote schedule

**Who Can Apply**

This internship is strictly for students who are at the beginning of their journey. You are a good fit if you are:

* 18 years of age or above
* A first-year or early-stage undergraduate student currently enrolled in a college or university
* New to content creation, with little or no prior experience in video editing or social media management
* Comfortable on camera, curious about social media, and eager to learn from scratch
* Self-motivated and able to manage your time in a remote setup

This programme is built for beginners, so experienced creators may find it too introductory.

**What You Will Need**

* A smartphone with a good-quality camera, or a dedicated camera
* A clean, well-lit, presentable location to use as your background

**Internship Details**

* **Duration:**
  3 months
* **Commitment:**
  1 to 2 hours per day
* **Mode:**
  Remote
* **Applications:**
  Open year-round, reviewed on a rolling basis

**Please Note**

This is a learning-focused internship with no monetary compensation involved. It is structured as a training programme, and its value lies in mentorship, guided practice, real project exposure, and a certificate and letter of recommendation that support your early career. Content created during the internship will be published on Uzi World Digital’s official channels and may be reused by the agency for brand purposes. You are welcome to share your work on your own profiles as well. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email within 7 days.

* Manage Cost of Distribution (COD) by optimizing inbound and outbound delivery (E2E) to control Total Delivered Cost (FDC / VDC / % COD).
* Drive Distribution Network Redesign, Logistics Excellence and related projects across delivery transportation and downstream warehouse operations.
* Prepare the Transport strategy along with T-Hub, onboard new carriers for downstream operations, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Complete formalities and ensure recovery of accident/loss claims for primary and secondary movements.

**Warehouse & DC Operations**

* Lead DC improvement projects – manpower productivity, MHE utilization, DIDO/GIGO improvement, warehouse utilization – ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Prepare warehouse strategy and manage new infrastructure transitions in line with business volume progression (OPL/MBS).
* Ensure 100% cycle count and inventory accuracy along with adherence to internal & external compliance guidelines.

**Service Levels & Customer Fulfilment**

* Maintain COF / OTIF / ZATP, reduce CD OOS and secondary OTRs.
* Resolve CD complaints related to shortages/damages and drive corrective actions.
* Coordinate with the Sales team and O2C team to onboard new customers post CSP alignment and ensure full supply.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure cool chain compliance in downstream storage and transportation (DC to Distributor).
* Drive batch traceability, reefer service and chilled service strategies.
* Adhere to the company charter on supply and distribution of Infant Milk Substitutes and Infant Foods.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Identify and deploy advanced process improvement tools in warehousing (WMS, Dock Management, RF Implementation).
* Implement digital solutions in transportation – Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility, Digital Hygiene Checklist, LCOP, ERC, OVT.
* Roll out all Distribution-related HO projects (LER, CLER, Trainings, LVS) at the unit level.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage vendors and ensure formal execution of agreements with DC owners, CFAs and Carriers.
* Trigger transport events on a real-time basis and ensure timely issuance of detention certificates.
* Maintain strong P2P process compliance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA / PGDM from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution (full-time).
* 2 – 5 years of relevant post-MBA experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Transportation or Distribution within FMCG / Consumer / Supply Chain-intensive industries.
* Mandatory experience in managing Warehousing Operations and Transportation Management.
* Strong experience in team management, stakeholder engagement, coordination with Sales and Order-to-Cash (O2C) teams, and end-to-end execution ownership.
* Exposure to transformation and automation projects in supply chain / logistics.
* Working knowledge of SAP, WMS, TMS and digital logistics tools (e.g., Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility).
* Understanding of the FMCG value chain, freight market trends, and transport costing (fixed vs. variable)
* Knowledge of the local language of the region is an added advantage.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

description:
**We're Hiring: Female Assistant to the CEO**
**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal, India (Preferred)
  
  
**Work Mode:**
100% Remote
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
Freshers to 2 Years
  
  
**Education:**
Graduation Preferred
  
  
Salary: ₹8,000 – ₹10,000 per month, depending on skills and suitability.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Female Assistant to the CEO to provide direct administrative, recruitment, and operational support to our CEO.
  
  
This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity suitable for freshers and candidates with up to 1 years of experience. The ideal candidate should have excellent English communication skills, good computer knowledge, strong organizational abilities, and an interest in executive assistance and US IT recruitment.
  
  
The candidate must be comfortable working during US business hours and coordinating with US-based professionals.
  
  
Working Hours
  
  
**US Eastern Time (ET): 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM**
**Corresponding India Time (IST)**

* During US Daylight Saving Time: 6:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST
* During US Standard Time: 7:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST

Candidates must be available for the full shift. Working hours in India will change according to the US daylight saving schedule.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Executive Assistance
* Provide direct administrative and operational support to the CEO.
* Manage assigned tasks, daily priorities, and follow-ups.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, and business activities.
* Assist with day-to-day administrative and operational requirements.
* Calendar and Meeting Management
* Manage the CEO's calendar and schedule appointments.
* Coordinate meetings and interviews across different time zones.
* Send meeting invitations, reminders, and follow-up communications.
* Ensure meetings and tasks are organized and completed on time.
* US IT Recruitment Support
* Assist with US IT recruitment and candidate sourcing activities.
* Review resumes and identify suitable candidates against job requirements.
* Communicate with candidates and coordinate interview schedules.
* Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and submission records.
* Follow up with candidates and recruiters regarding submissions and interview status.
* Support the recruitment team in day-to-day hiring activities.
* Documentation and Reporting
* Prepare and maintain documents, reports, and recruitment trackers.
* Work regularly with Google Docs and Google Sheets.
* Use Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for documentation, data management, and presentations.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure information is organized and up to date.
* Communication and Coordination
* Communicate professionally with US-based candidates, colleagues, and business associates.
* Assist with email correspondence and routine follow-ups.
* Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Handle multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good computer knowledge and proficiency in everyday office applications.
* Working knowledge of Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to multitask, follow instructions, and manage deadlines.
* Attention to detail and a proactive, responsible attitude.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Willingness and availability to work full-time during US business hours.
* Must have a personal computer or laptop and a reliable, high-speed internet connection.

Experience and Education
  
  

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with 0–2 years of experience in administration, executive assistance, recruitment
* Graduation in any discipline is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of IT, software technologies, or the IT industry will be an advantage.
* Previous exposure to US IT recruitment, HR operations, or executive assistance is desirable but not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Female candidates are preferred for this position, subject to applicable employment laws and LinkedIn's hiring policies.
* Candidates based in Kolkata, West Bengal, are preferred.
* Candidates who are comfortable working night shifts in India and coordinating with US-based professionals are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should be dependable, eager to learn, professional, and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to handle confidential business information professionally are essential.

Work Requirements
  
  

* 100% remote work.
* Full-time commitment during US Eastern Time business hours.
* Own computer or laptop is mandatory.
* Stable, high-speed internet connection is mandatory.
* Excellent English communication and professional conduct are essential.
* Ability to maintain productivity and coordinate effectively with a US-based team during the designated shift.

Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is ideal for freshers and early-career professionals who want to gain practical experience in executive assistance, recruitment coordination, and US IT staffing operations.
  
  
If you are organized, comfortable using computers, eager to learn, and capable of managing responsibilities independently, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Please apply only if you can commit to full-time remote work during the specified US business hours and have your own computer and a reliable internet connection.
  
  
**Join us and become an important part of our executive support and recruitment operations team!**

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Strassenburg Pharmaceuticals Limited is a pharmaceuticals manufacturing and marketing company based in Kolkata, India. The organization focuses on producing and promoting quality pharmaceutical products for diverse healthcare needs. As a growing company in the Greater Kolkata Area, Strassenburg offers opportunities to contribute to the healthcare sector through effective talent management and organizational development. Team members work in a dynamic environment that values compliance, operational efficiency, and responsible business practices. The company encourages collaboration, integrity, and long-term career growth.

**Role Description**
The Recruitment Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. In this role, the Recruitment Manager oversees end-to-end hiring processes, including workforce planning, job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection for various functions across the organization. The position is responsible for building effective recruitment strategies, partnering with hiring managers to understand role requirements, and ensuring a consistent, inclusive candidate experience. Daily tasks include managing recruitment metrics, coordinating with external agencies or platforms, conducting reference checks, and supporting offer negotiation and onboarding activities. The Recruitment Manager also contributes to employer branding initiatives, maintains compliance with relevant labor laws and company policies, and continuously improves recruitment processes through data and feedback.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated skills in talent acquisition, including candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection for diverse roles.
* Experience developing and executing recruitment strategies, workforce planning, and collaborating closely with hiring managers.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to manage multiple requisitions, prioritize tasks, and use recruitment tools or applicant tracking systems efficiently.
* Knowledge of relevant labor laws, industry regulations, and best practices in fair, non-discriminatory hiring.
* Prior experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or manufacturing environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced HR certifications are beneficial.
* Proven ability to analyze recruitment data, track key metrics, and recommend process improvements.

• Create a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and ethical business practices.

Comfortable working in uncertainty and solving real-world problems daily

Handle execution, investors, operations, growth, and team building, etc.

Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience across startups, scale-ups, or complex businesses.
  
**\***
Proven track record of building and scaling businesses from early stages.
  
**\***
Experience working across Food / Consumer \* Brands, HealthTech & FMCG or Consumer Goods.
  
**\***
Demonstrated experience in P&L ownership, fundraising, and team leadership.
  
  
**Strategic & Execution Skills**
**\***
Strong ability to think long-term while executing relentlessly in the present.
  
**\***
Deep understanding of consumer behavior, operational complexity, and scalability.
  
**\***
Comfort navigating regulated or semi-regulated sectors.

title: Academy AF A ContentAggregator
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior content aggregation specialist within the Academy AF A function designing and operating robust hybrid solutions that unify learning data and digital assets from diverse enterprise and external sources. Apply expertise in Net SQL Python and modern generative AI platforms including Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to curate classify and expose high quality training content. Deliver reliable day shift outcomes that elevate organizational capability and societal impact through ac
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain scalable content aggregation workflows that collect normalize and classify learning materials from internal repositories and approved external sources to ensure a unified and reliable Academy catalog.
* Develop and optimize Net based services and APIs that securely expose aggregated content to front end applications and downstream platforms while maintaining high performance and reliability.
* Create robust Python scripts and automation routines to process metadata perform text transformation and orchestrate batch ingestion jobs that keep the content library current and comprehensive.
* Use SQL to design efficient data models queries and procedures that support fast retrieval advanced filtering and detailed reporting across the consolidated learning content store.
* Apply Gemini AI to generate insightful summaries recommend relevant learning paths and enrich metadata so that employees can quickly discover material that supports their growth and productivity.
* Apply Claude capabilities to analyze long form learning content extract key concepts and improve instructional clarity enhancing the overall quality and accessibility of Academy assets.
* Apply Open AI models to enable personalized content suggestions conversational search and adaptive learning experiences that improve engagement and skill acquisition for diverse learners.
* Collaborate closely with instructional designers and subject matter experts to validate aggregated content refine taxonomies and ensure alignment with enterprise learning objectives and compliance standards.
* Implement robust data quality checks observability metrics and issue resolution routines that minimize broken links duplicate records and outdated material across hybrid content pipelines.
* Document aggregation processes data flows and integration patterns in clear operational guides that enable consistent day shift support and smooth handoffs among distributed team members.
* Coordinate with platform engineers and security specialists to ensure that all integrations data movements and AI workloads comply with governance requirements and protect sensitive information.
* Monitor usage analytics feedback signals and content performance indicators to propose targeted improvements that enhance learning outcomes and amplify the impact of Academy programs on society.
* Drive continuous refinement of hybrid work practices using collaboration tools and structured communication methods so that onsite and remote team members deliver cohesive and predictable content services.

**Qualifications**

* Bring seven to eleven years of experience working with enterprise grade content or data platforms demonstrating accountability for end to end aggregation curation and delivery outcomes in complex environments.
* Show advanced proficiency in Net application development with emphasis on building secure and modular services that integrate seamlessly with databases APIs and generative AI platforms.
* Demonstrate strong SQL skills in designing normalized schemas writing optimized queries and tuning data workloads to support analytics reporting and rapid content discovery.
* Exhibit deep Python expertise in building automation frameworks data processing utilities and integration scripts that manage large volumes of structured and unstructured learning materials.
* Provide hands on experience working with Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to design practical solutions for summarization classification recommendation and conversational access to learning content.
* Offer a track record of operating effectively in hybrid work models by using digital collaboration tools documenting workflows and maintaining consistent communication during standard day shifts.
* Prefer prior exposure to corporate learning ecosystems or digital education platforms where content aggregation curation standards and learner centric experiences were central responsibilities.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Net Developer and Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer or equivalent cloud data qualification relevant to SQL and Python.

title: Creative / Design Head
description:
**We’re Hiring | Creative / Design Head**

Kass • Full-Time Opportunity • Kolkata

**Role :**
Creative / Design Head

**Location :**
Kolkata (Work From Office)

**Experience & Availability :**
2–3+ Years • Immediate to 30 Days

**About Kass**

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**
thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**
who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**
, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**
  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**
  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**
  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**
  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**
  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**
  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**
  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**
  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**
  the department’s operational backbone, designing organizational systems and workflows that eliminate creative bottlenecks.
* **Integrate modern automation tools**
  , node-based workflows, and emerging AI technologies into daily production to exponentially scale asset variations and multiply team efficiency.
* **Collaborate closely**
  with Marketing, Performance, Product, and Operations to translate commercial goals into actionable creative solutions with minimal turnaround time.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Proven Leadership:**
  Demonstrated track record leading, managing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary creative or design team in a high-velocity environment (D2C, agency, or high-growth consumer brand).
* **Aesthetic & Technical Mastery:**
  Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) with strong working knowledge of 3D workflows, motion graphics, and emerging AI creative tools.
* **On-Set Production Eye:**
  Solid understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and macro product shooting.
* **Systems Thinker:**
  Someone who doesn’t just design, but builds scalable pipelines, templates, and automated workflows to elevate the entire department’s output.
* **D2C Performance Sense:**
  Deep intuition for modern consumer psychology, thumb-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and conversion-focused design.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts, Design, Animation, Visual Communication, or an equivalent battle-tested industry portfolio.

**Why Kass?**

At Kass, creative production is not an afterthought—it is the central engine of our brand equity and customer acquisition. If you have the vision to shape a rapidly scaling skincare brand and the operational muscle to lead a high-performing creative floor, we’d love to hear from you.

Send your
**cv**
and
**portfolio**
to sayani.bhattacharya@kasscare.com

Agro-API-Fine-Chemicals

title: Operations Executive (SCP)
description:
**Job Title**
: Executive Operations
  
  
**Function**
