+ Provide operational insights on trends, errors, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
+ Support performance dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.

* Stakeholder Support

+ Support managers and employees with payroll and time system issues.
+ Coordinate resolution of systemic issues impacting payroll and time experience.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Identify upstream process improvements to reduce payroll and time risk and manual intervention.
+ Support automation and simplification of time and payroll enablement activities.

* 8+ Years of Experience with strong understanding of payroll optimization, reporting and analytics, with hands-on experience in Power BI, dashboards, KPI monitoring and data-driven decision-making.

* Strong stakeholder coordination and problem-solving capability.

title: Principal Engineer - Process
description:
**Job Description**
To manage and execute the delivery of best practice process design and associated services in designated studies, projects, and consulting services, in alignment with wood organizational objectives and client requirements. To provide corporate oversight in terms of technical quality of designs globally Provide technical leadership for a designated area of activity within the Process Group, this includes technology development.
  
  
Skilled in managing project activities from conceptualization to execution including process circuit design, plant designing, equipment selection, process optimization, procurement, technical specifications, stage inspections, progress monitoring, site management, Supervision and erection ensuring compliance with the Quality, Time, and Cost Management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Completing conceptual and/or detailed process engineering designs of new or revamp/additions to existing facilities.
* Developing design basis documents (process design criteria, mass, energy, and water balances etc.) and reports.
* Design, supervise metallurgical test work programs and analysing results to develop/optimize flowsheet.
* Conceptualizing flowsheet, Review of Metallurgical test work, design development, Process Simulations, Mass & Water balance, Utility Summary, PFD, equipment sizing calculation and selection i.e., Cyclone, Pumps, Dewatering screens, Tanks Valves, Crusher, feeders, sand washing plant and all other associated equipment like Columns Heat Exchangers, working on process design basis and criteria, basic & detail engineering deliverables, Vendor support etc.
* Perform Hydraulic Calculations for circuits (Slurry service and non-slurry service – Newtonian and Non-Newtonian fluid both)
* Plant auditing, debottlenecking, and optimization
* Carrying out calculations, design development and process simulations including providing specifications for process equipment and instrumentation.
* Creating, reviewing, and revising process deliverables such as PFDs, P&IDs, line lists, control philosophies, cause and effect matrix and data sheets.
* Perform Hydraulic Calculations for circuits (Slurry service and non-slurry service – Newtonian and Non-Newtonian fluid both)
* Relief Load Estimation by scenario analysis and Preparation of PSV datasheets, cause and effect diagram, process control narrative, Sequence Interlock Diagrams, Operating manual / procedure. Lead in HAZOP and other safety studies.
* Preparing Operating Cost estimate and aid in the development of Capital Cost estimate.
* Interfacing and coordination between other discipline engineers and project management staff.
* Reviewing and applying relevant standards, regulations, codes, and guidelines applicable for task, identifying areas of deviation or concern.
* Responsible for working within and following company work procedures, process technical guidelines, quality assurance plans, safety regulations and specific customer/project procedures.

Demonstrated commitment to quality and continuous learning

Participate in Quality initiatives and suggest modifications or improvements to current procedures if required.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* A Bachelor or Masters degree in Metallurgy, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering required.
* Senior level (12+ years) of relevant professional

**Technical And Industry Experience**

* Strong computer skills, proficient with MS Office software.
* Experience in using METSIM, SysCAD, HSC, Aspen and other process simulation software is considered an asset.
* Ability to deliver best practice plant design, with emphasis on cost-effective engineering.
* Ability to recognize the commercial implications in study, project and proposal execution.

Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

title: Study Abroad Tele Counselling
description:
**Company Description**

Studies In Overseas (SIO) is a comprehensive study abroad advisory organization that supports learners in planning and pursuing international education. SIO offers guidance on admissions to 800+ universities and colleges across more than 33 countries, including major destinations such as the USA, UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Italy, Germany, and France. The team focuses on providing personalized counselling to help individuals choose the right programs and institutions aligned with their goals. SIO values trust and aims to deliver a human-touch experience with speed and accuracy throughout the study abroad journey. The organization is committed to turning global education aspirations into achievable plans.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Study Abroad Tele Counselling role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves handling inbound and outbound calls to counsel prospective learners and families on suitable countries, universities, programs, eligibility criteria, and application timelines. The individual will explain admission processes, documentation requirements, and standardized tests, and guide applicants through shortlisting institutions according to academic background, budget, and career goals. Daily tasks include maintaining detailed records in CRM systems, following up with leads, coordinating with internal teams for applications and offers, and providing regular updates to applicants. The role also includes responding to queries via phone, email, and messaging platforms, participating in promotional campaigns, and contributing to webinars or information sessions about studying abroad.

**Qualifications**

* Strong counselling and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex admission and visa information clearly and empathetically.
* Proficiency in telecalling and customer service, including handling high call volumes, lead follow-up, and relationship building.
* Good organizational and documentation skills, with experience using CRM or similar tools to track enquiries, applications, and follow-ups.
* Awareness of international education systems, popular study destinations, and admission processes; prior experience in overseas education consulting is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, collaborate in a team environment, and meet targets and deadlines.
* Comfortable using digital tools for communication (email, chat, video calls) and basic office software (word processing, spreadsheets, presentations).
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a background in education, counselling, or related fields is preferred.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of regional languages is beneficial for engaging a wider range of applicants.

description:
* Position: Senior SAP PS Consultant
* Location: Bengaluru (On-site)
* Experience: 8+ years in SAP, including 6+ years in SAP PS
* Budget: Up to 1.2 lakh per month
* Availability: Immediate joiners only
* Project: BIAL Airport Infrastructure Programme

**Job Description**
**Senior SAP PS (Project System) Consultant**
Contract | 8+ years | Bengaluru (on-site) | BIAL airport infrastructure programme
  
  
Position
  
  
Senior SAP PS (Project System) Consultant
  
  
Engagement type
  
  
Fixed-term contract, [duration] months, extendable based on project need and performance
  
  
Client / project
  
  
Bangalore International Airport Limited (BIAL) capital projects and infrastructure programme
  
  
Location
  
  
Bengaluru, Karnataka on-site at the client location (Kempegowda International Airport, Devanahalli)
  
  
Total experience
  
  
8+ years in SAP, of which at least 6 years in SAP PS
  
  
Implementations
  
  
Minimum 2 end-to-end SAP PS implementations, at least 1 on SAP S/4HANA
  
  
Availability
  
  
Immediate to 30 days preferred
  
  

* Role summary

ATC is looking for a hands-on Senior SAP PS Consultant to lead the Project System workstream for BIAL s capital and infrastructure programme. You will design, configure and support the full project lifecycle in SAP: structuring, planning, budgeting, procurement, execution, progress measurement, settlement to fixed assets and reporting. The role calls for deep knowledge of PS configuration and of its integration with CO, FI-AA, IM, MM, SD and PM in an asset-heavy, capex-led environment.
  
  

* Key responsibilities

**2.1 Solution design and configuration**

* Lead requirement workshops with BIAL s project, engineering, finance and procurement teams, and turn capex processes into SAP PS designs (business blueprint / fit-to-standard, functional design documents).
* Design the project structure: project definition, WBS hierarchy, networks, activities (internal, external, general cost and service), activity elements and milestones, aligned to BIAL s capital project, cost-centre and asset classes.
* Configure project profiles, network profiles, network types, coding masks, number ranges, status profiles, budget and planning profiles, settlement profiles, results analysis and progress analysis.
* Build and maintain standard structures (standard WBS and standard networks) for repeatable airport project types such as terminal works, airside works, utilities, landside and IT infrastructure.

**2.2 Cost planning, budgeting and availability control**

* Set up cost planning by structure, Easy Cost Planning, unit costing and network costing, using appropriate costing variants and planning versions.
* Configure budgeting: original budget, supplements, returns, transfers, releases and budget carry-forward at year end.
* Design and test availability control: tolerance limits, activity groups, actions (warning, error, e-mail) and exempt cost elements, and activate and reconstruct availability control.
* Integrate PS with Investment Management (IM): investment programmes, positions, appropriation requests, programme budget distribution to WBS elements, and IM PS budget consistency.

**2.3 Execution, procurement and logistics integration**

* Configure MM integration: purchase requisitions from external and service activities, account assignment to WBS and network, material components, reservations, project stock (valuated and non-valuated) and MRP for project materials.
* Configure service procurement for contractor works (service entry sheets) and commitment management against WBS budgets.
* Set up confirmations (individual, collective, CATS timesheets), confirmation parameters, work centres, activity types and capacity planning.
* Configure dates and scheduling: basic, forecast and actual dates; scheduling parameters; relationships (FS, SS, FF, SF); float; and network rescheduling.
* Integrate PM work orders and maintenance costs with WBS elements where needed.

**2.4 Progress, revenue and period-end**

* Configure progress analysis and earned value management: progress versions, measurement methods (milestone, start finish, degree of processing, time-proportional, quantity proportional, estimation) and POC reporting.
* Configure results analysis (RA keys, RA versions, valuation methods including POC and revenue-based) where projects are billable or revenue-bearing.
* Configure billing integration where applicable: milestone billing, billing plans, down payments and resource-related billing (DIP profile).
* Configure and run settlement: settlement rules, settlement profiles, allocation and source structures, periodic and full settlement, and settlement of assets under construction (AuC) to final fixed assets, including line-item settlement.
* Support period-end and year-end processes: overhead calculation (costing sheets), interest calculation, results analysis, settlement, commitments carry-forward and budget carry-forward.

**2.5 Reporting, testing, data and support**

* Deliver PS reporting: structure overview, cost and budget reports, line-item reports, commitment and payment reports, and S/4HANA Fiori analytics, as well as custom reports through functional specifications.
* Write functional specifications for RICEFW objects (reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows) and work with ABAP and integration teams to deliver them.
* Lead data migration for projects, WBS, networks, budgets and open commitments using the S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, LSMW or BAPIs.
* Plan and run unit, integration (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT); prepare test scripts; and resolve defects.
* Prepare training material and end-user guides, train key users, provide hypercare after go-live, and handle incidents and change requests within agreed service levels.
* Technical skills matrix

Candidates must show hands-on experience, not just awareness, in the areas marked Mandatory.
  
  
**Area**
**Level**
**Technical scope (objects, configuration, transactions)**
Project structure
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Project definition, WBS elements, networks, activities, activity elements, milestones; operative indicators (planning, account assignment, billing); Project Builder (CJ20N), CJ01 CJ03, CN21 CN23; standard WBS (CJ91) and standard network (CN01)
  
  
Core configuration
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Project profile (OPSA), network profile (OPUU), network type (OPSC), project coding mask (OPSJ), status profile (OK02) with system and user status, field selection, validations and substitutions
  
  
Cost planning
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Planning profile (OPSB), structure planning (CJ40), Easy Cost Planning (CKCM), network costing, costing variants, plan versions
  
  
Budgeting and availability control
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Budget profile (OPS9), original budget (CJ30), supplement / return (CJ37 / CJ38), release (CJ32), budget carry-forward (CJCO), availability control activation and reconstruction (CJBV / CJBN), tolerance limits
  
  
Investment Management
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Investment programmes and positions, appropriation requests, programme budget distribution, IM-to-WBS budget flow, AuC management
  
  
Procurement and materials
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
External and service activities, PR/PO account assignment to WBS and network, material components (CN22), reservations, project stock (valuated / non-valuated), service entry sheets, commitment management
  
  
Dates, scheduling and capacity
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Scheduling parameters, relationships, float, forward and backward scheduling, CN24N, work centres (CR01), capacity evaluation (CM01), workforce planning
  
  
Confirmations
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
CN25 individual and CN27 collective confirmation, CATS (CAT2) time entry and transfer, confirmation parameters
  
  
Settlement and fixed assets
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Settlement rules, settlement profile (OKO7), allocation structure (OKO6), source structure, individual / collective settlement (CJ88 / CJ8G), AuC line-item settlement to final assets, FI-AA integration
  
  
Progress and earned value
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Progress versions, measurement techniques, progress analysis (CNE1 / CNE5), earned value, POC
  
  
Results analysis and billing
  
  
**Preferred**
RA keys and versions (KKA2 / KKAJ), milestone billing, billing plans, down payments, resource-related billing (DP91, DIP profile)
  
  
Period-end
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Overhead (costing sheet), interest calculation (CJZ2), commitments and budget carry-forward, settlement cycles, period-end closing sequence
  
  
Information system
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
CN41N structure overview, CN43N, CJI3 / CJI4 / CJI5 line items, budget actual commitment reports, PS info system profiles, database profiles
  
  
SAP S/4HANA
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Universal Journal (ACDOCA) impact on PS reporting, S/4HANA simplification items for PS, Fiori apps for project monitoring and control, Migration Cockpit (LTMC / LTMOM)
  
  
Enhancements and interfaces
  
  
**Preferred**
Customer fields on WBS (CI\_PRPS), PS user exits and BAdIs, BAPIs (BAPI\_PROJECT\_MAINTAIN, BAPI\_BUS2054\_\*, BAPI\_NETWORK\_MAINTAIN), IDocs; Primavera P6 / MS Project integration
  
  
Portfolio and project management
  
  
Good to have
  
  
SAP PPM / S/4HANA Portfolio and Project Management, Commercial Project Management (CPM), document management (DMS) and claim management
  
  

* Mandatory requirements
* 8+ years of SAP experience, with at least 6 years of hands-on SAP PS configuration.
* At least 2 full-cycle SAP PS implementations, including at least 1 on SAP S/4HANA, plus experience in support or rollout projects.
* Strong grasp of capex and capital project accounting: budgeting, availability control, AuC and capitalisation.
* Proven integration experience with CO, FI-AA, IM and MM; working knowledge of SD and PM integration.
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with ABAP, BTP and integration teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, at the client location, for the full engagement.
* Preferred requirements
* Domain experience in airports, aviation, infrastructure, EPC, construction, utilities or the public sector.
* Experience integrating SAP PS with Primavera P6 or MS Project for scheduling.
* Exposure to SAP Activate methodology and SAP Solution Manager or SAP Cloud ALM.
* SAP certification in Project System or S/4HANA Portfolio and Project Management.
* Bachelor s degree in engineering, finance, commerce or a related field; MBA or CA / ICWA is an advantage.
* Behavioural competencies
* Clear communication with senior client stakeholders in project, engineering and finance teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to documentation.
* Ability to work independently in a client-facing, deadline-driven programme.
* Ownership of deliverables and quality, from design through to hypercare.

+ OTC (Order to Cash)
+ P2P (Procure to Pay)
+ R2R (Record to Report)
+ Manufacturing / Digital Supply Chain

* In-depth knowledge of S/4HANA data objects within the candidate's core functional areas.
* Technical & Process Capabilities

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for data modeling, mapping, and project reporting.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities to navigate complex business workflows.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting solutions to business stakeholders.
* Strong team player capable of working effectively in multi-disciplinary project teams.

* SAP Certification: Official SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Transportation Management.
* Exposure to integrated S/4HANA Supply Chain modules (e.g., EWM, SD, MM).
* Prior experience with data migration tools and data loading processes.

BT Group is one of the world’s leading communications services companies, providing solutions that are essential to modern life. Guided by the purpose “we connect for good,” BT Group focuses on enabling individuals, businesses, and communities to communicate and collaborate effectively. As technology reshapes how people live and work, the company’s networks and services support customers in staying connected and productive. BT Group plays a key role in addressing global challenges such as pandemics, climate change, and cyber security through innovative, technology-driven solutions. Team members contribute to meaningful work that helps people live, work, and play better together.

**Role Description**
The Technical Management Professional Networks role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves managing and optimizing network infrastructure, monitoring performance, and ensuring high availability and reliability of services. Day-to-day responsibilities include troubleshooting network issues, coordinating with internal teams and external partners, and implementing changes and upgrades in line with best practices and security standards. The professional will prepare and maintain technical documentation, support incident and problem management, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. The role also includes collaborating with stakeholders to align network operations with business objectives and customer experience goals.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in computer networks, including routing, switching, network protocols, and basic security principles.
* Experience with network monitoring, incident management, and troubleshooting tools in an operational or technical support environment.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, create clear reports, and maintain accurate records of network configurations and changes.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional teams and interact with stakeholders at different levels.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on service quality and reliability.
* Willingness to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area and adapt to evolving technologies, processes, and business needs.
* Industry certifications in networking or telecommunications (e.g., CCNA, Network+, or equivalents) are beneficial.

title: O365 L1/L2 Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for experienced O365 (Microsoft 365) L1/L2 Support Engineers to provide technical support, troubleshoot Microsoft 365 applications, and ensure smooth day-to-day IT operations for enterprise users.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide L1/L2 technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Troubleshoot Outlook, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive issues.
* Manage user accounts, license assignments, password resets, and access permissions.
* Resolve email delivery, mailbox configuration, calendar, and connectivity issues.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, authentication, and user provisioning.
* Perform basic administration using Microsoft 365 Admin Center and Exchange Admin Center.
* Handle incidents and service requests through ITSM/ticketing tools while meeting defined SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to L3 or relevant technical teams.
* Maintain incident records, troubleshooting documentation, and operational procedures.
* Provide remote end-user support and ensure timely incident resolution.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Minimum 4+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 / O365 technical support.
* Hands-on experience in L1/L2 support and incident management.
* Strong troubleshooting knowledge of Outlook and Exchange Online.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, user provisioning, and license management.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, ticket management, and SLA-based support.
* Good communication, customer service, and troubleshooting skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience supporting enterprise users in a corporate IT environment.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Candidates must have 4+ years of relevant Microsoft 365/O365 support experience.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a hybrid model from NCR, Mumbai, or Kolkata.
* Strong customer service orientation and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently are essential.

**Keywords:**
O365 Support, Microsoft 365, L1 Support, L2 Support, Outlook, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, Azure AD, MFA, ITSM, Incident Management, SLA, PowerShell.
  
  
Skills: sharepoint,support,azure ad,microsoft 365,onedrive,o365

title: Senior Specialist - IT Digital Workplace
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Senior Specialist in this position will ensure workplace services within the M365 and Global Workplace Services organization meet business needs. Will also design, build, optimize, and maintain secure, efficient Windows client services using defined standards and policies in a cost-effective manner. And provide expert support for the SCCM platform, including Windows client management, compliance, deployment/provisioning, patching, and software distribution. Lastly, act as a key contributor to global initiatives, primarily focused on Intune technologies.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* You will be managing SCCM/MECM infrastructure, OSD, task sequences, collections, feature updates, compliance, and L3 support
* Designing and maintaining Windows 10/11 client standards, images, lifecycle management, and Evergreen strategy
* You will also lead hardware, driver, firmware, and Windows upgrade management
* Developing and automating solutions using PowerShell
* Also, create compliance reports, deployment documentation, and operational runbooks
* Lastly, support global projects, major incidents, and on-call rotations

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* A degree or equivalent from a reputed institute, Formal training and/ or certification in Intune / Modern Desktop, SCCM & Microsoft Technologies
* Five to eight (5-8) years of relevant IT experience working with reputed companies. Good technical knowledge in the Intune /MECM Infrastructure
* Experience working in a global or distributed team (preferred, not mandatory). And strong English communication skills
* You have expertise and technical proficiency in IT Workplace services (preferably Intune) and working experience in medium to large enterprise environments
* And you have strong knowledge in Software Deployment– MSI / EXE packaging, Powershell deployments, Detection methods, Requirement rules
* Device Configuration - Configuration Profiles, Administrative Templates, Settings Catalog, Custom OMA-URI Policies
* Azure Virtual Desktop – management of, host pools, app groups, sessions hosts, image management, FSLogix
* Windows Validation - OS Compatibility Testing, Application Readiness Testing, Driver Validation, Upgrade Validation

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

title: App User Retention Executive

•  Seasonal campaigns

•  PR and media outreach

•  Develop strategies to increase DAU/MAU and user retention.

•  Build lifecycle campaigns such as:

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech / B.E. from IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institutes, or an equivalent heavily quantitative/analytical background.

**Experience & Competencies**

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

**The Perks**

* Direct Impact:You aren’t just running campaigns or updating a dashboard; you are actively engineering the growth engine of an autonomous business unit.
* Intellectual Autonomy:We foster a high-trust, fast-paced environment where hierarchy takes a backseat—data and logical arguments always win.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Tech Lead.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:

•   Current CTC

•   Expected CTC

•   Notice period

•   Current location

•   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

title: Business and Growth Intern
description:
Business & Growth Intern

Duration: 6 Months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Kolkata

Company: PopLotus (Nutralike Superfoods Pvt. Ltd.)

Role Summary

PopLotus is a growing Indian snacking brand focused on building the next generation of premium, better-for-you makhana products. As a Business & Growth Intern, you will work closely with the core team across multiple functions of the business and gain hands-on exposure to how a consumer brand is built and scaled.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role designed for someone who wants to understand the complete business rather than work within a single function. Your responsibilities will span e-commerce and quick commerce, exports and foreign trade, business analytics, marketing and brand building, general trade, logistics, and HR/business operations.

You will be expected to take ownership of projects, work with data, identify opportunities, coordinate with external partners, and contribute directly to business decisions.

What Success Looks Like
  

Success in this role means becoming someone the core team can rely on to independently take a problem, analyse it, execute a solution, and measure the outcome.

By the end of the internship, you should have developed a strong understanding of how a consumer/FMCG business operates across online, offline, domestic and international channels, while having contributed tangible results to PopLotus' growth.

Responsibilities
  

* Support the growth and management of PopLotus across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms, including marketplace operations, catalogue management, pricing, promotions, inventory and platform performance.
* Analyse sales, customer, SKU and channel-level data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data-driven dashboards and reports to track sales, margins, inventory, channel performance and other key business metrics.
* Support foreign trade and export development, including identifying potential buyers and distributors, researching international markets, generating leads, coordinating samples, and assisting with export documentation and follow-ups.
* Research international markets data to identify potential opportunities for Indian makhana and better-for-you snacking products, including competitor, pricing and market analysis.
* Contribute to brand building and marketing initiatives, including campaign planning, content coordination, market research, consumer insights and competitor tracking.
* Assist in expanding PopLotus' general trade and distribution network, including distributor research, retailer mapping, lead generation, outreach and sales coordination.
* Develop an understanding of the Indian makhana and FMCG snacking ecosystem, including sourcing, grades, pricing, competitors, distribution models and consumer trends.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, warehouses, vendors and internal teams to support inventory movement, order fulfilment, dispatches and operational efficiency.
* Assist with vendor and partner coordination across different business functions and ensure timely follow-ups and execution.
* Support HR and people operations, including recruitment coordination, candidate screening, onboarding, intern coordination and other day-to-day HR activities.
* Conduct market and competitor research across products, brands, pricing, distribution, consumer behaviour and emerging trends.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic and operational projects that contribute to the growth and development of PopLotus.
* Work closely with the founding/core team and provide regular updates on project progress, findings, challenges and recommendations.

Qualifications
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Economics, Marketing, Finance or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to work comfortably with numbers and data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with data analysis and dashboards is an advantage.
* Strong research skills and the ability to independently find, interpret and present information.
* Interest in FMCG, D2C brands, e-commerce, quick commerce, exports, consumer businesses or startups.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where responsibilities can evolve quickly.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, distributors, logistics partners and other external stakeholders.

What You Will Gain

* Hands-on exposure to building and scaling an FMCG consumer brand from the ground up.
* Exposure to e-commerce, quick commerce, general trade and international markets.
* Practical experience in exports and foreign trade.
* Experience working with real business data and making data-driven decisions.
* Direct interaction with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional exposure across sales, marketing, operations, logistics, analytics and HR.
* An opportunity to take ownership of projects with measurable business impact.

title: Oracle Cloud EAM Consultant

**Join us at**
**iteria.us**
With over 25 years of proven success,
**iteria.us**
has earned a reputation for delivering exceptional IT services and application managed solutions. We specialize

**iteria.us**
, we don’t just solve problems - we help our clients evolve.
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Functional Consultant specializing in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have deep functional expertise in implementing and supporting Oracle Cloud EAM applications, with a strong focus on maintenance management, asset lifecycle optimization, and comprehensive preventive and corrective maintenance strategies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the functional implementation and support of Oracle Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) modules as a subject matter expert, with demonstrated experience in at least two full cycle implementations.
* Work closely with clients to understand their comprehensive maintenance management needs, including preventive maintenance schedules, corrective maintenance workflows, and strategic asset management requirements.
* Analyze gathered business requirements and design robust EAM system configurations to meet specific client operational needs, ensuring optimal asset performance and maintenance efficiency.
* Possess hands-on expertise in configuring Oracle Maintenance modules including Oracle Enterprise Asset Management (eAM), Oracle Maintenance Cloud, and Oracle Enterprise Asset Management Cloud applications.
* Implement complex functional solutions for asset lifecycle management, work order processing, inventory integration, and maintenance scheduling using deep knowledge of Oracle EAM suite and proven problem-solving methodologies.
* Design and configure maintenance strategies, preventive maintenance programs, asset hierarchies, and work management processes to streamline maintenance operations and maximize asset availability.
* Lead Conference Room Pilots (CRPs) and User Acceptance Testing (UATs) sessions, facilitating stakeholder engagement and ensuring system functionality aligns with business requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive end-user training sessions to familiarize clients with EAM system functionality, best practices, and optimal utilization strategies for maintenance management.
* Develop detailed documentation including user manuals, training guides, system configuration documents, and process workflows to support successful system adoption and knowledge transfer.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders to deliver Oracle ERP projects on time and within budget constraints.
* Demonstrate proficiency in Oracle data tools including Application Development Framework Desktop Integration (ADFDI) and File-Based Data Import (FBDI) for efficient data migration and system integration.
* Configure asset management processes including asset registration, condition monitoring, reliability analysis, and maintenance cost tracking to support data-driven maintenance decisions.
* Work closely with integration teams to ensure seamless connectivity between EAM modules and other Oracle Cloud applications including Procurement, Inventory, and Financial modules.
* Provide ongoing functional support and system optimization recommendations to enhance maintenance efficiency and asset performance metrics.
* Stay current with Oracle Cloud quarterly releases and EAM functionality enhancements, evaluating and implementing relevant features to improve maintenance management capabilities.

**Required Skills**

* A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud EAM applications is essential, with demonstrated expertise in at least two full cycle implementations.
* Proven experience in functional configuration of Oracle Enterprise Asset Management (eAM), Oracle Maintenance Cloud, or Oracle Enterprise Asset Management Cloud modules.
* Strong understanding of maintenance management business processes including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, predictive maintenance, and asset lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle data tools including ADFDI and FBDI for data loading, migration, and integration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct Conference Room Pilots (CRPs), User Acceptance Testing (UATs), and comprehensive end-user training programs.
* Experience in creating functional documentation including user manuals, training guides, and system configuration documentation.
* Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams in enterprise-level Oracle ERP project implementations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into functional system configurations.
* Strong multitasking abilities with focus on release priorities and deliverables within the Oracle Fusion applications context.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Oracle certifications in relevant ERP modules, EAM applications, or Oracle Cloud technologies.
* Knowledge of Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) report writing and analytics capabilities.
* Experience with asset management best practices across various industries including manufacturing, utilities, healthcare, or facilities management.
* Understanding of integration touchpoints between EAM and other enterprise systems including CMMS, ERP, and IoT platforms.
* Excellent collaboration skills with proven ability to work with diverse stakeholder groups and manage client relationships effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
* Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and SaaS deployment models.

**Why join iteria.us?**
This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI transformation. At iteria.us, you’ll work with forward-thinking clients, build game-changing strategies, and help shape the future of AI adoption across industries.
  
  
iteria.us offers a comprehensive benefits package, paid time off, and an employee centric culture.

With over 30 years of proven success in IT Services and Application Management, iteria.us was founded to bring back what’s often missing in consulting—true customer service.
  
  
We saw an industry drifting toward one-size-fits-all solutions that benefited vendors more than clients, so iteria.us was created to change that. Our experienced consultants focus on what matters most: delivering tailored, streamlined solutions that align with your business goals, not someone else’s agenda.
  
  
What sets us apart? A flexible model combining on-site and nearshore talent, a dedication to quality, and a client-first mindset that drives results.

* Implementations

**www.graystone\-capital.com**

**About us** 




 Graystone Capital arranges and structures debt financing for businesses across the GCC and wider region. We work with clients on trade finance, working capital, and structured credit, connecting them to the right funding partners.
 



  





**The role** 




 We're looking for an HR Generalist to own the people function end to end. This is a hands\-on role in a lean team, you won't be handing work off to a department, you'll be doing it, from drafting an offer letter in the morning to sitting in on a difficult conversation in the afternoon.
 



  





 You'll be the person who makes sure the firm is compliant, that people are paid correctly and on time, and that someone joining us from outside the UAE has a visa, a bank account, and a desk on day one. Discretion is non\-negotiable.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run the full employee lifecycle, offers, contracts, onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, and final settlements
* Manage visa, work permit, Emirates ID, and medical processes end to end, coordinating with PROs and government portals
* Prepare and maintain employment contracts and ensure they reflect current UAE labour law and internal policy
* Own monthly payroll input and WPS submission, including allowances, deductions, leave, and end\-of\-service calculations
* Administer medical insurance, renewals, additions, and claims support
* Coordinate recruitment, job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, references, and offer negotiation support
* Maintain accurate personnel files, leave records, and HR documentation with absolute confidentiality
* Advise managers on disciplinary matters, grievances, probation reviews, and performance issues
* Run the performance review cycle and keep KPI documentation current across the team
* Draft and update HR policies, the employee handbook, and internal communications
* Track compliance deadlines — visa expiries, passport validity, insurance renewals, labour card renewals
* Support leadership with headcount planning, cost reporting, and HR data on request



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Three or more years in a generalist HR role in the UAE, covering both operations and employee relations
* Working knowledge of UAE Federal Decree\-Law No. 33 of 2021, MOHRE procedures, and WPS requirements
* Hands\-on experience with visa and immigration processes — MOHRE, GDRFA, and free zone portals
* Strong drafting ability in English; able to write contracts, policies, and sensitive correspondence without supervision
* Sound judgement with confidential and commercially sensitive information
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word; experience with an HRIS an advantage
* Organised and self\-directed — comfortable being the only HR person in the room
* Calm and even\-handed in difficult conversations
* Experience in financial services, banking, or professional services an advantage
* Bachelor's degree in HR, business, or a related field
* CIPD or SHRM certification an advantage
* Arabic an advantage for government and PRO liaison



  





**Why join us** 




 You'll own the HR function rather than inherit a slice of it, and you'll work directly with leadership on decisions that shape how the firm grows. We're a lean team, so what you build here will be the way things are done.

 Full\-time

title: Piping Engineer / Senior Piping Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Piping Engineer with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Piping Design \& Layout Engineering:
+ Develop piping layouts for mining, mineral processing, and metal extraction facilities based on P\&IDs, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and client specifications.
+ Ensure the layout design optimizes space, operational efficiency, and ease of installation while meeting industry safety and environmental standards.
+ Prepare detailed piping design drawings, including routing, support placement, and equipment integration.
+ Coordinate the layout of piping systems with other engineering disciplines such as civil, mechanical, and electrical to ensure seamless integration.
+ Select appropriate materials for piping systems based on factors such as fluid type, temperature, pressure, and environmental conditions.

* FEED (Front\-End Engineering Design):
+ Participate in the FEED phase of projects, assisting in the development of piping layouts and preliminary designs.
+ Work with multidisciplinary teams to define project scope, estimate costs, and identify potential design challenges.
+ Review client specifications and ensure the design aligns with technical, budgetary, and scheduling requirements.
+ Contribute to the development of initial piping design concepts, material take\-offs, and cost estimates.

* Detailed Engineering Design:
+ Prepare detailed engineering designs for the full scope of piping systems, including pipe sizes, materials, valves, and fittings, as well as system integration.
+ Use S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar CAD software to develop accurate piping design drawings and layouts.
+ Coordinate with the stress analysis team to address any piping support and stress\-related issues.
+ Ensure that all piping designs comply with applicable industry standards and codes (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, etc.).

* Layout Optimization:
+ Optimize piping layout designs for both new projects and modifications to existing plants by minimizing material usage, reducing installation time, and enhancing operational efficiency.
+ Review existing designs to identify potential areas for improvement and ensure that the piping layout adheres to best practices and operational needs.

* Coordination \& Communication:
+ Work closely with internal teams, clients, contractors, and vendors to ensure the timely and successful completion of projects.
+ Participate in 3D design reviews, safety meetings, and project coordination meetings to track progress and mitigate risks.
+ Maintain clear and consistent communication regarding project milestones, design changes, and any potential challenges.

* Quality Control \& Compliance:
+ Ensure the piping design meets quality standards and safety regulations in accordance with project requirements, local regulations, and industry codes.
+ Perform thorough checks to confirm design accuracy, material selection, and compliance with specifications.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in piping design, layout engineering, and detailed engineering in the mining, mineral, and metal industries or related heavy industries.
* Proficient in S3D, E3D, AutoCAD, Microstation, Plant 3D, or similar 3D CAD software used for piping design.
* In\-depth knowledge of piping codes and standards (e.g., ASME, API, ANSI, ISO) and the ability to apply them effectively in design.
* Experience in FEED and detailed design phases of projects, from initial concept to final design.
* Familiarity with stress analysis and material selection for various operating conditions (pressure, temperature, and corrosion resistance).
* Strong understanding of piping layout principles, including routing, spacing, support design, and integration with equipment and structures.
* Experience working on large\-scale mining or metallurgical plant projects.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Position Purpose
 
 The Operations \& Strategy Lead acts as the chief liaison and operational bridge between the Promoter/Managing Director and the factory floor. Stationed permanently at the plant, this person ensures strict execution of management directives, monitors operational and financial KPIs across production and utilities, tracks customer dispatches and receivables, and coordinates business development initiatives.
 



 This is a high\-ownership operational role for a commercially sharp operator who wants to learn how to run a mid\-market industrial manufacturing enterprise.
 



  





**Location:** 
 On\-site daily at Manufacturing Facility, Hooghly, West Bengal
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Managing Director / Promoter
 



**Working Relationship:** 
 Works alongside the Plant Head, QA/QC Lead, and Commercial Accounts Team
 



**Experience Level:** 
 3–6 years post\-MBA (or equivalent operational experience)
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Promoter Cockpit \& Daily Plant Governance
 * Review and validate the Daily Production Report (DPR) generated by the plant team
* Independently flag operational anomalies, line stoppages, unapproved material consumption, or safety/maintenance lapses directly to the Managing Director.
* Track the daily utility consumption and performance metrics of the HVAC systems, chillers, and newly commissioned heat pump systems against baseline power targets.
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and management directives are rigorously implemented across the shop\-floor staff.
* Prepare monthly executive MIS presentations detailing gross margins, direct cost breakdowns, debtor aging, and capacity utilisation trends for promoter review.



  




 2\. Commercial Coordination, Dispatches \& Working Capital
 * Act as the daily bridge between customer orders and plant production schedules, ensuring priority batches for key institutional accounts are produced and packaged on schedule.
* Track raw material inventory levels and reconcile daily consumption against purchasing ledgers to prevent stockouts or over\-procurement.
* Coordinate daily logistics, freight haulers, and e\-way billing for on\-time dispatches to formulation hubs in North, West, and East India.
* Assist the Managing Director in monitoring customer ledger aging, coordinating with client procurement desks to resolve dispatch disputes, and ensuring customer collection cycles remain strictly within the targeted 60–90 day window.



  




 3\. Business Development \& Sales Enablement
 * Handle inbound sales inquiries, coordinate commercial price quotations and track customer sampling for line trials.
* Actively manage the commercial follow\-up for export vendor qualifications (coordinating regulatory documentation, sample logistics, and questionnaire completion)
* Liaise with in\-country indenters, domestic sales reps, and customer procurement teams to resolve commercial, invoicing, or packaging grievances before they escalate.



  




 Candidate Profile \& Qualifications
 * **Education:** 
 Full\-time MBA (Operations, Supply Chain, or General Management) from a reputable institute. A prior Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or B.Pharm is a distinct advantage.
* **Experience:** 
 3 to 6 years of operational experience in a manufacturing plant environment, industrial B2B enterprise, supply chain role, or as an EA to a Promoter/CXO in an industrial setup.



  





**Core Competencies:** 



* **High Integrity \& Discretion:** 
 Able to maintain strict confidentiality and serve as a reliable, unbiased reporting source for the promoter.
* **Diplomatic Authority:** 
 Capable of auditing plant floor performance and asking tough questions without creating destructive friction with the experienced technical Plant Head.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** 
 Strong fluency in P\&L basics, working capital cycles, debtor aging, and spreadsheet\-based operational modeling.
* **Language Proficiency:** 
 Fluent in English and Bengali (essential for daily communication with the local shop\-floor team and local contractors); working Hindi proficiency preferred for interstate client handling.

* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

 The Senior Specialist in this position should be a highly skilled Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator to support and advance our enterprise self service BI strategy. title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.
