 Head / Senior Officer – Training \& Placement
 



**About the Role** 




 Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is seeking a dynamic, proactive, and result\-oriented
 **Training \& Placement Officer** 
 to support and strengthen the activities of the Training \& Placement and Corporate Relations Cell.
 



 The incumbent will be responsible for coordinating student training programs, internships, campus recruitment drives, employer interactions, career development initiatives, and placement\-related activities across various academic departments. The role requires strong communication, coordination, networking, documentation, and follow\-up skills, along with the ability to work closely with students, faculty members, management, and corporate recruiters.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Training \& Student Development** 



* Coordinate and support training programs designed to improve students' employability and industry readiness.
* Organize aptitude training, soft\-skills training, communication skills, interview preparation, group discussions, and other career development programs.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, guest lectures, industry sessions, career counselling programs, and pre\-placement talks.
* Identify students' training requirements in coordination with academic departments.
* Maintain records of student participation, attendance, performance, and training outcomes.



**2\. Placement \& Recruitment Coordination** 



* Coordinate campus recruitment drives from initial communication with recruiters through completion of the recruitment process.
* Assist in identifying and inviting companies for campus placement and internship opportunities.
* Coordinate student registration, eligibility verification, shortlisting, and communication with candidates.
* Schedule aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds, HR interviews, and other recruitment activities.
* Ensure timely communication of recruitment schedules, instructions, and requirements to students and concerned departments.
* Support recruiters during campus visits and ensure smooth execution of placement activities.



**3\. Corporate \& Employer Relations** 



* Develop and maintain professional relationships with HR professionals, recruiters, corporate organizations, and industry representatives.
* Assist in identifying new companies and industry partners for placements, internships, training, and institutional collaborations.
* Maintain an updated database of recruiters, corporate contacts, placement partners, and industry organizations.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with recruiters regarding placement opportunities and recruitment requirements.
* Assist in coordinating corporate meetings, industry visits, MoUs, and other institutional\-industry engagement activities.



**4\. Internship Coordination** 



* Coordinate internship opportunities for students with suitable organizations.
* Communicate internship requirements and opportunities to students and academic departments.
* Assist in collecting and maintaining internship\-related documents and records.
* Track student internship status, joining, completion, and feedback.
* Maintain an updated internship database and submit periodic reports to the concerned authority.



**5\. Student Coordination \& Support** 



* Guide students regarding placement registration, eligibility criteria, recruitment procedures, interview schedules, and required documentation.
* Maintain regular communication with students regarding placement and training activities.
* Assist students in preparing resumes/CVs and other placement\-related documents.
* Coordinate student participation in off\-campus and on\-campus recruitment activities.
* Address routine student queries related to training, internships, and placements and escalate matters where required.



**6\. MIS, Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate records of student profiles, placement status, internship details, recruiter information, and training activities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and event\-wise reports as required by the Management.
* Maintain placement and training MIS in Excel/Google Sheets or other institutional systems.
* Track placement targets, recruitment drives, student participation, selections, offers, internships, and joining status.
* Ensure proper documentation of all Training \& Placement activities.



**7\. Coordination with Academic Departments** 



* Work closely with Principals, HODs, faculty members, and academic coordinators to identify placement and training requirements.
* Coordinate department\-wise student data and placement eligibility information.
* Ensure participation of students from different departments in relevant training and placement initiatives.
* Support academic departments in improving student placement readiness.



**8\. Event \& Activity Management** 



* Assist in planning and executing placement drives, job fairs, career fairs, industry interactions, seminars, workshops, and recruitment events.
* Coordinate venue, seating, registration, student attendance, recruiter requirements, and other logistical arrangements.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination among recruiters, students, faculty members, and administrative teams.



**9\. External Visits \& Field Coordination** 



* Visit corporate offices, companies, training organizations, and industry partners as required.
* Assist in corporate meetings, business development activities, industry visits, and placement\-related institutional collaborations.
* Willingness to travel within and outside Kolkata/West Bengal for placement and corporate relations activities, as required.



**10\. Additional Responsibilities** 



* Support the Senior Training \& Placement Officer / Head of the Department in achieving institutional placement and training objectives.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management from time to time in connection with Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations, Student Development, or Institutional Activities.



**Eligibility \& Qualification** 




**Essential Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institution.
* Minimum
 **6\-7 years of relevant experience** 
 in Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations,



**Preferred Qualification** 



* Master's Degree in Management, HR, Business Administration, Education, or a relevant discipline.
* Prior experience in an educational institution, university, college, training organization will be preferred.



**Essential Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Good presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly
 **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Ability to maintain MIS, databases, reports, and official documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with students, faculty members, management, and corporate representatives.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for corporate meetings, recruitment drives, industry visits, and institutional activities.



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 The ideal candidate should be:
 


* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Confident and professional in communication.
* Well\-organized and disciplined.
* Comfortable interacting with students, faculty, management, and corporate professionals.
* Capable of working independently as well as part of a team.
* Flexible to handle multiple responsibilities and institutional requirements.
* Willing to take initiative and build long\-term corporate relationships.



**Why Join KEI?** 



* Opportunity to work with a growing and diverse educational institution.

* Opportunity to develop expertise in Training \& Placement and Corporate Relations.
* Professional growth in the education and employability\-development sector.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to student career development and institutional placement initiatives.

title: Senior Dealer
description:
**Company Description** 
 SMIFS Limited is a leading wealth management and financial services company with over three decades of experience supporting investors, high\-net\-worth individuals, corporates, and institutions across India. Founded in 1991, the firm is driven by a client\-first philosophy, research\-backed decisions, and disciplined risk management. SMIFS offers comprehensive solutions across wealth management, equities and market access, insurance, institutional services, and structured and legacy planning. The company focuses on tailored financial strategies that align with client goals, risk profiles, and life stages, helping them navigate market cycles and build long\-term wealth. SMIFS operates under multiple SEBI, AMFI, IRDAI, and other regulatory registrations, reinforcing its commitment to compliance and trust.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Dealer role is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Kolkata, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Senior Dealer will execute and manage equity, derivatives, and other market orders on behalf of clients, ensuring timely and accurate trade execution in line with regulatory norms and internal risk guidelines. Responsibilities include monitoring markets in real time, analyzing trading opportunities, managing client positions, and coordinating with the research and advisory teams to implement recommended strategies. The role involves regular interaction with clients and relationship managers to understand investment objectives, provide execution\-related insights, and maintain a high standard of service. The Senior Dealer will also contribute to compliance reporting, trade reconciliations, and continuous improvement of dealing desk processes and systems.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of capital markets, including equities, derivatives, and other traded instruments, along with practical experience on major exchanges and trading platforms.
* Proficiency in trade execution, order management, position monitoring, and risk management within a regulated dealing environment.
* Ability to interpret market research, technical and fundamental analysis, and apply them to day\-to\-day trading and client strategies.
* Excellent numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort working with trading software, OMS/RMS systems, and Excel\-based tools.
* Clear, professional communication skills to interact with clients, relationship managers, and internal teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements related to brokerage, trading, and client order handling.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, commerce, economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM, NCFM) are preferred.
* Prior experience in a dealing desk role with a brokerage, wealth management, or financial services firm is highly beneficial.

title: Executive Assistant to the President
description:
**SRMB STEEL** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Executive Assistant to the President \& CSMO** 




**Position Title** 




 Executive Assistant (EA) to the President \& Chief Sales and Marketing Officer
 



**Reports To** 




 President \& CSMO (single reporting line)
 



**Base Location** 




 Kolkata, Corporate Head Office (anchors HQ operations during principal's field travel)
 



**Function / Band** 




 Executive Office / Business Support (Senior Manager equivalent)
 



**Experience Required** 




 12\+ years as EA to a Director / CXO in a large manufacturing organization (non\-negotiable)
 



**Span of Coordination** 




 Interfaces with 10 direct reports of the CSMO, HODs, plant \& regional sales leadership, and the MD's office
 



  





**1\. Purpose of the Role** 




 SRMB Steel is scaling toward a ₹5,000 Cr turnover ambition, and the Office of the President \& CSMO sits at the centre of that push. This office consolidates every sales, marketing, MIS and analytics stream while the CSMO spends much of the next twelve months in the field, driving the retail run across a digital\-rich, multi\-brand product architecture (core TMT, binding range, structural\-retail brands and the project/institutional business).
 



 The Executive Assistant is the operating spine of this office. Not a diary\-keeper, but a trusted second brain: someone who runs the HQ cockpit when the principal is travelling, keeps information flowing without friction, turns raw data into decision\-ready briefs, and protects the CSMO's time and focus with judgement and discretion. This is a career EA role for a seasoned professional who takes quiet pride in flawless execution.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Executive Office \& Time Management** 



* **Calendar command:** 
 Own the CSMO's calendar end\-to\-end: prioritising, sequencing and defending time against competing demands from HODs, the MD's office, dealers, and external partners.
* **Operating rhythm:** 
 Run the daily and weekly operating rhythm: pre\-empt what the principal needs before each meeting, prepare the day's brief, and close the loop on every open action.
* **HQ anchor:** 
 Act as the HQ anchor while the CSMO is in the field: a reliable point of contact who keeps the office moving, escalates only what matters, and never lets a commitment slip.



**B. Communication \& Gatekeeping** 



* **First point of contact:** 
 Serve as the first point of contact for the office, screening calls, mail and requests with tact, filtering noise, and routing the right matters to the right people.
* **Correspondence:** 
 Draft, edit and dispatch correspondence, notes and communications on the CSMO's behalf in a crisp, professional voice.
* **Representation:** 
 Represent the office of the President with warmth and poise to internal teams, channel partners and senior external stakeholders.



**C. Data, MIS \& Digital Enablement** 



* **MIS consolidation:** 
 Consolidate KRO / Sales\-MIS streams from HODs into clean, single\-source dashboards and review packs, and flag exceptions before they are asked for.

title: Blender 3D Generalist
description:
**We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest\-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.** 




**We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.** 




  





**🎬 Role Description** 




  





**Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.** 




**You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, with a lead who reviews your work.** 




  





**📅 A typical week** 




  




* One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
* You animate. Layout, body, expressions, camera.
* Your lead reviews before you start lighting. Notes come back the same day.
* You do the lighting and either render yourself or give us your file and we render for you.
* You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never just keep waiting for a review.



  





**🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work** 




  




* Render farm access. Your laptop/PC is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
* NO Lip syncing req to be done from your end. we take care of it.
* A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
* An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
* Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
* A named lead who reviews your work and gives you go ahead.
* A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.



  





**💰 Compensation and how you grow here:** 




  





**We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.** 




  





**Tier 3 — ₹5,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.** 




  





**Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000\. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1\.** 




  





**Tier 1 — ₹7,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹70,000–₹84,000\. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000\. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.** 




  





**Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.** 




  





**Two things worth saying plainly.** 




  





**None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.** 




  





**Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.** 




  





**Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.** 




  





**✅ Qualifications** 




  





**You need to be strong in Blender at:** 



* Layout and scene setup
* Character animation — body mechanics, facial expressions.
* Camera animation
* Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable
* lighting and rendering.



  





**And you need to be someone who:** 



* Can own a full video without being chased
* Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly
* Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.
* lighting and rendering.



  





 We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.
 



  





 ▶️ The work we make
 



  




* https://youtu.be/YFcFDlAsSO4
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF\-mI
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb\-qOTao



 Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.

* Fill the form: https://join.thefutureanimations.com/apply

title: Video Editor
description:
**Role Description** 




 iLEAD Kolkata is looking for a
 **full\-time Social Media Video Editor** 
 who understands how to edit for attention, retention, and platform\-native storytelling.
 



 This role is for someone who is creatively sharp, visually curious, and technically strong, with a strong instinct for
 **Instagram Reels, Facebook content, short\-form videos, digital promos, event content, and campaign\-driven social edits** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who does more than just “follow the brief.”
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to take raw footage, understand the intent, and build a strong fine cut using
 **their own creative judgement** 
 . Someone who knows when to cut faster, when to hold a moment, when motion graphics will elevate an edit, and when they will simply get in the way.
 



 A strong understanding of
 **Instagram\-native editing, current trends, pacing, hooks, transitions, motion graphics, sound design, and visual retention** 
 is essential.
 



 The editor should be confident using
 **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 , and should also have a working understanding of
 **AI tools** 
 that can support editing, ideation, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, and workflow efficiency.
 



 And yes, creativity matters.
 



 But so does accountability.
 



 We are looking for someone who can experiment, think independently, and still
 **deliver quality work on time** 
 .
 



 We’re open to a
 **flexible work setup** 
 , including remote work.
 



 What matters to us is simple:
 **good communication, ownership of your edits, and delivering great work on time.** 




 The exact working arrangement can be discussed during the interview based on what works best for the role and the candidate.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Edit
 **high\-quality social media reels** 
 and short\-form videos for digital platforms
* Work on content for
 **Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, campaigns, events, and promotional communication**
* Create edits that feel
 **current, platform\-native, visually engaging, and brand relevant**
* Use
 **Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 effectively based on project requirements
* Add
 **motion graphics, text animation, transitions, sound design, and finishing polish** 
 where required
* Understand social media behaviour and edit with a strong focus on
 **hook, pacing, retention, and visual engagement**
* Keep track of
 **current editing trends, Reel formats, visual styles, and internet culture**
* Take ownership of edits and build strong fine cuts without requiring step\-by\-step direction for every decision
* Collaborate with the creative and marketing team to execute content in line with brand and campaign needs
* Use relevant
 **AI tools** 
 to improve editing workflows, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, ideation, and productivity
* Manage multiple projects while maintaining
 **quality, consistency, and turnaround timelines**



  




 Experience
 
**Freshers are welcome to apply.** 




 But there is one condition.
 



 Your portfolio needs to be strong.
 



 We are far more interested in
 **what you can create** 
 than how many years you have been creating it.
 



 If your edits make us stop and think,
 



**“Okay. Who edited THIS?”** 




 we want to see them.
 



 Send us your
 **CV \+ your best editing portfolio/showreel** 
 .
 



 And please do not send every edit you have ever made.
 



**Send us the work you are genuinely proud of.** 




**Location** 




**iLEAD Kolkata** 




  





**To Apply** 




 Please share your
 **CV, portfolio/showreel, and relevant work links** 
 .

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\- Senior AI Engineer – IAM \& Cybersecurity**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist ( Onsite Kolkata)
description:
Job Title: Insurance Verification \& Authorization Specialist
   

  

 Experience: 1–2 years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Location: Preferably Kolkata, or candidates willing to relocate to Kolkata
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented Insurance Verification \& Authorization Specialist with experience in customer service, healthcare administration, insurance verification, or managed care. The ideal candidate will be responsible for verifying insurance benefits, obtaining required authorizations, communicating coverage details, and ensuring all payer requirements are completed before services are provided.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Contact insurance carriers to verify active policy status, co\-pays, deductibles, coinsurance, out\-of\-pocket maximums, and provider network status.
   

  

 Obtain and track pre\-authorizations and Letters of Agreement required by payers for specific treatments, services, or medical devices.
   

  

 Communicate insurance coverage details and estimated patient financial responsibility to providers and relevant teams.
   

  

 Resolve insurance discrepancies in coordination with clinical and billing departments.
   

  

 Accurately document insurance information, coordination of benefits, and authorization approval or denial outcomes.
   

  

 Update patient information in Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), or practice management systems.
   

  

 Ensure all payer requirements are fulfilled before the scheduled service.
   

  

 Support the revenue cycle by preventing claim delays and minimizing front\-end billing errors.
   

  

 Follow up on pending authorizations and maintain accurate records of all verification activities.
   

  

 Shift time: 5\.30 PM to 2\.30 AM
   

  

 Work from Office
   

  

 Salary up to \-3\.6 LPA
   

  

 Exp\- 1yr \+
   

  

 Requirements:
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 1–2 years of experience in customer service, healthcare administration, insurance verification, or managed care.
   

  

 Medical billing experience will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Knowledge of insurance policies, benefits verification, and authorization procedures.
   

  

 Basic proficiency with EMR/EHR or practice management software.
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up abilities.
   

  

 Ability to coordinate effectively with insurance companies, providers, clinical teams, and billing departments.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience working with commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or other healthcare payers.
   

  

 Familiarity with in\-network and out\-of\-network benefits.
   

  

 Ability to explain insurance coverage and patient responsibility clearly.
   

  

 Strong organizational and time\-management skills.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Company:** 
  AniGears Engineering Solutions
 



**Location:** 
  Kolkata, West Bengal
 



**Experience:** 
  0–3 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
  ITI / Diploma / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
 



**Salary:** 
  ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month
 



**Travel:** 
  Approximately 20 days/month
   




 About AniGears
 
 AniGears Engineering Solutions is an engineering company specialising in industrial power transmission and rolling mill equipment. Our product range includes gear couplings, pin \& bush couplings, resilient couplings, cardan shafts, sprockets, pulleys, gearboxes, gear motors and other customised mechanical components.
 



 We are looking for a 
 **Mechanical Engineer** 
  who is technically strong, hands\-on, comfortable with field work, and willing to travel extensively to customer sites.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Mechanical Design \& Drawings** 



* Prepare and modify 
 **2D Mechanical drawings using AutoCAD** 
 .
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of 
 **SolidWorks / 3D modelling** 
 .
* Prepare 3D models and engineering drawings as required.
* Convert hand sketches and site measurements into proper engineering drawings.
* Understand mechanical components, dimensions, tolerances and fits.



**2\. Reverse Engineering** 



* Visit customer sites and inspect existing mechanical components.
* Take accurate measurements using:
* Vernier Caliper
* Outside/Inside Caliper
* Micrometer
* Vernier Height Gauge
* Measuring Tape and other measuring instruments
* Understand component geometry and prepare hand sketches.
* Reverse engineer components and develop drawings/models for manufacturing.
* Coordinate with vendors/manufacturers for technical execution.



**3\. Customer \& Site Visits** 



* Regularly visit steel plants, rolling mills, engineering industries and other industrial customers.
* Meet 
 **maintenance/technical users, mechanical departments and purchase teams** 
 .
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products.
* Technically explain AniGears' products and applications.
* Develop new customer relationships and generate enquiries.
* Handle technical discussions as well as basic commercial discussions.
* **Candidate must be comfortable travelling at very short notice.**
* Approximately 
 **20 days of travel per month** 
  may be required.


 Skills Required
 * Good knowledge of 
 **Mechanical Engineering fundamentals** 
 .
* AutoCAD – 2D drafting.
* Basic knowledge of SolidWorks / 3D modelling.
* Ability to read and understand mechanical drawings.
* Strong understanding of dimensions, measurements, fits and tolerances.
* Practical knowledge of measuring instruments.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively.
* Ability to work independently at customer sites.
* Basic commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
* Strong follow\-up and execution ability.


 Who We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


* **Hands\-on and technically curious** 
 , rather than purely desk\-oriented.
* Comfortable visiting factories and industrial sites.
* Confident interacting with senior engineers, maintenance teams and purchase personnel.
* Willing to learn industrial products and applications.
* Comfortable with frequent travel and changing schedules.
* Able to take ownership of an enquiry from 
 **site visit → measurement → drawing → quotation → follow\-up → order** 
 .


 Qualification
 
**ITI / Diploma / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** 




 Freshers with strong practical knowledge and willingness to travel are welcome to apply. Candidates with 
 **1–3 years of experience in industrial sales, mechanical design, manufacturing, power transmission, rolling mills or engineering products** 
  will be preferred.
   




 Compensation
 
**₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month** 
 , depending on qualification, experience and capability.
 



 Travel expenses and applicable allowances will be provided as per company policy.
   




 Location
 
**Kolkata, West Bengal** 



* **Important:** 
  This is a field\-oriented role. Candidates who are looking for a purely office\-based Mechanical Engineer position may not be suitable.

title: Manager - Creative Solutions
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 LoglineAI turns client and brand briefs into original content — brand films, campaigns, micro\-dramas — across cinematic animation, live\-action, and AI\-generated formats, all run through our in\-house LoglineOS pipeline. This role owns the translation: from a raw brief to a sharp creative concept and a pitch that wins the client, while making sure the creative vision survives contact with production.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the creative response to client and brand briefs — from first read to concept, pitch deck, and final creative direction.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into original creative concepts for brand films, campaigns, micro\-dramas, and branded content.
* Lead ideation sessions and shape concepts that work across cinematic animation, live\-action, and AI\-generated formats.
* Build and present compelling pitch decks and creative presentations directly to clients and producers.
* Partner closely with the AI/production pipeline (LoglineOS) so creative vision survives production without losing craft.
* Guide and review work from junior creative and client servicing team members.
* Stay current on branded content, OTT, and micro\-drama trends to keep LoglineAI's creative offering sharp.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience in creative/brand solutions, advertising, content studio, or OTT — in concept development, brand campaigns, or pitch creation.
* Strong storytelling instincts and presentation skills; comfortable pitching directly to clients.
* A portfolio demonstrating original creative concepts taken from brief to execution.
* Working understanding of production formats — branded films, social content, micro\-dramas, or series.
* Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Canva AI, Notion AI) for research, concepting, and first drafts, while protecting brand voice and originality.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with AI\-generation tools for creative production (image/video generation, AI voiceover).
* Background in agency or entertainment industry

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

**Company Description** 
 Arth Early Learning Spaces is a Reggio inspired preschool founded on the belief that all children are competent, capable, and eager to learn, and that every child deserves the opportunity to experience success in school.

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

* Experience building APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Understanding of monitoring, observability, and system reliability

* Experience building agent\-based or autonomous AI systems
* Cost optimization for LLM workloads
* Multi\-modal AI (text, image, voice)
* Frontend integration for AI\-driven experiences

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ Data Engineering, or related field

title: Manager- CSR Fundraising
description:
**Job Title: Manager / Sr. Associate / Sr. Manager \- Fund\-raising \& Corporate Partnerships** 




  





 Location: Goa/Ahmedabad/Kolkata/Jamshedpur
 



  





 Job Type: Full\-time
 



  





**About the Company: (e1 e1\)** 




  





 Each One and Educate One Foundation is a leading organization committed to making a positive impact on society through its various initiatives in the field of Education. Our mission is to drive sustainable development and community engagement through strategic partnerships and innovative scholarship programs.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




  





 The Fund\-raiser will play a crucial role in identifying and generating both Corporate and HNI leads for our Corporate \& Individual Social Responsibility initiatives. This role requires a proactive and dynamic individual who can generate leads, identify potential partners, build relationships, and convert them into active \& recurring engagements that align with our CSR \& Fund\-raising goals. The candidate must have a strong understanding of CSR Policies, Procedures, Processes, Compliance, Due Diligence, Impact Monitoring \& Reporting, combined with excellent networking skills, and the ability to engage with diverse stakeholders.
 



  





 Candidate should have an exposure to the Education Ecosystem in India (private \& public) and related Government policies and initiatives.
 



  





**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




  




1. **Lead Generation:**



  




* Identify and research potential CSR partners \& Donors, including corporations, foundations in India \& abroad, Government agencies, and other relevant organizations.
* Generate and qualify leads through various channels, including online research, networking events, industry conferences, and referrals.
* Maintain a comprehensive database \& pipeline of potential partners, with robust follow\-up strategies \& methodologies including regular tracking \& reporting of all the outreach and engagement activities.



  




1. **Networking and Relationship Building:**



  




* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including CSR Personnel, CXOs, CEOs, Directors \& Manging Directors, influential Community Leaders, and Industry Leaders.
* Attend Industry events, CSR conferences \& awards functions, and relevant meetings to expand the organization’s network and CSR Partner base.
* Collaborate with internal teams to leverage existing relationships and identify new opportunities for partnerships.



  




1. **Strategic Planning:**



  




* Develop and implement strategies to effectively generate CSR interest in our interventions and realise partnership goals.
* Analyse market trends and industry developments to identify new opportunities for CSR engagement.
* Contribute to the development of CSR\-focused programs and initiatives by providing insights and recommendations based on lead generation \& CSR engagement activities.



  





**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




1. **Communication and Outreach:**



  




* Prepare and deliver presentations, proposals, and curated pitches to potential partners.
* Create compelling marketing materials, including brochures, newsletters, and social media content, to build, expand, nurture and sustain CSR Partners and other potent fund\-raising avenues.
* Collaborate with the Communications team to develop and execute outreach campaigns targeting potential CSR partners.



  




1. **Reporting and Analysis:**



  




* Analyse lead generation data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Tracking and reporting regularly as decided by the HOD regarding lead generation activities, number of leads generated, presentations made, proposals submitted \& converted, conversion rates, and other outreach outcomes.
* Provide regular updates to the Head of the Institution / CSR Head or Director / Chief Functionary on the progress with respect to lead\-generation, outreach, presentation \& proposals, fund\-raising projections and actuals vs projections.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Social Sciences, or a related field. (MSW or TISS etc)
* Proven 4\-5 years of experience in lead generation, engagement and conversion / business development, or a similar role, preferably within the social sector.
* Strong understanding of Corporate Social Responsibility principles and practices.
* Excellent networking, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in using CRM software and lead generation tools.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Passion for social impact and sustainability.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.

title: Advertising Account Manager
description:
As an advertising Account Manager, you'll work within an advertising or multi\-service agency, acting as a link between the agency and its clients. You'll be responsible for the coordination of advertising campaigns and therefore communicating clearly to all those involved. You may also be known as an account handler.
 



  





 It is vital to understand the needs of your clients, which you'll learn through liaising closely with them throughout campaigns, often on a daily basis. You'll also manage administrative and campaign work to ensure that advertising projects are completed on time and on budget.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As an advertising Account Manager, you'll need to:
 


* meet and liaise with clients to discuss and identify their marketing requirements
* work with agency colleagues to devise an advertising campaign that meets the client's brief and budget
* present (alongside agency colleagues \- particularly the account manager) the campaign ideas and budget to the client
* work with the agency heads to brief media, creative and research staff and assist with the formulation of marketing strategies
* liaise with, and act as the link between, the client and the advertising agency by maintaining regular contact with both
* ensure that communication flows effectively
* negotiate with clients and agency staff about the details of campaigns
* present creative work to clients for approval or modification
* handle budgets, manage campaign costs, and invoice clients
* write client reports
* monitor the effectiveness of campaigns
* undertake administrative tasks
* arrange and attend meetings
* make pitches, along with other agency staff, with the aim of securing new business for the agency.



  





**What to expect** 



* Although you'll generally be office\-based, travel within the working day is frequent as you'll be expected to visit clients and may attend TV shoots, radio recordings or castings. Absence from home overnight and overseas work or travel is occasionally required.
* The working environment is generally informal, although the smart dress is often the norm. The role can involve socializing with clients.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Although this area of work is open to all graduates, a degree or HND in the following subjects may improve your chances, especially as advertising is an increasingly competitive sector to enter:
 


* advertising
* business/management
* communications
* English
* marketing



  





**Skills** 




 You will need to show evidence of the following:
 


* excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* a proactive attitude, with the ability to use initiative
* excellent organizational skills
* the ability to work under pressure and assimilate large quantities of information quickly, while maintaining attention to detail
* drive
* flexibility
* effective teamworking skills
* influencing and negotiation skills
* oral and written communication skills
* commercial awareness
* a passion for advertising and an understanding of what makes a good advertisement
* a willingness to learn
* resilience, to enable you to deal with problems and constructive criticism
* IT literacy and an awareness of how the industry is developing in light of new communication technologies.



  





 Please apply with your CV to ankit@meraqi.in

title: Mechanical & Process Design

**Role \& Responsibilities**

* Expertise in process design, equipment sizing and selection, development of engineering deliverables, vendor engineering, and multidisciplinary coordination across all phases of EPC projects.

 Full\-time MTech/BE/BTech/Diploma/ITI in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university/institute.

title: Community Manager
description:
COMMUNITY MANAGER – MEHICO
 
**Brand:** 
 Mehico
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



**Department:** 
 Community, Events \& Business Development
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Operations / Management
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 


 ABOUT THE ROLE
 
 Mehico is looking for a
 **high\-energy, well\-connected Community Manager** 
 who understands Kolkata's social, corporate and nightlife crowd and can turn that network into
 **regular guests, events and revenue** 
 .
 



 This is not a traditional social\-media or community\-management role.
 



 The person will be responsible for
 **building the right community around Mehico, bringing people into the restaurant, curating commercially viable events and ensuring that every activation contributes to the business.** 




 The ideal candidate should know
 **where Kolkata's crowd is, who the key people are, what they like to do, and how to get them to Mehico.** 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Community Building
 * Build and manage a strong Mehico community comprising:
* Young professionals
* Entrepreneurs
* Corporate professionals
* Creatives
* Influencers
* Social groups
* College/alumni communities
* Lifestyle communities
* Nightlife crowd
* Event organisers
* Develop strong relationships with key people who can influence guest traffic.
* Maintain an active guest and community database.
* Convert one\-time visitors into regular Mehico guests.
* Build a community that identifies Mehico as a place to
 **meet, celebrate and socialise** 
 .


 2\. Guest Acquisition
 
 The primary objective is
 **bringing people through the door** 
 .
 


* Personally develop relationships with potential guests and community leaders.
* Drive guest traffic through networking and direct outreach.
* Create guest lists for events and ensure strong attendance.
* Develop partnerships with relevant communities, companies, clubs and groups.
* Drive repeat visits through personalised engagement.
* Track the number and quality of guests generated through each initiative.


 3\. Event Curation
 * Conceptualise and curate events that are relevant to Mehico's brand and target audience.
* Develop a monthly event calendar.
* Create recurring properties rather than one\-off events.
* Examples may include:
* Ladies' nights
* DJ nights
* Latin nights
* Salsa/Bachata evenings
* Corporate socials
* Networking evenings
* Community meet\-ups
* Themed parties
* Brand collaborations
* Influencer/community events
* Festive events
* Private parties
* Identify emerging trends and formats that can generate guest traffic.
* Work with the Operations, Bar, Kitchen and Marketing teams to execute events.


 4\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 
**Every event must have a commercial objective.** 




 The Community Manager will be responsible for ensuring that events are not conducted merely for visibility or social\-media content.
 



 For every event, the candidate should evaluate:
 


* Expected guest count
* Expected revenue
* Average spend per guest
* Food revenue
* Beverage revenue
* Event costs
* Artist/entertainment costs
* Marketing costs
* Complimentary/discount impact
* Contribution/profitability



 The candidate must be able to answer:
 



**"How much business will this event generate, what will it cost us, and what will we actually make?"** 



 5\. Event P\&L
 * Prepare event\-level revenue and cost projections.
* Track actual revenue against projections.
* Ensure events meet agreed profitability thresholds.
* Negotiate with artists, performers, collaborators and vendors within approved budgets.
* Avoid unnecessary complimentary spends and excessive discounts.
* Conduct post\-event profitability analysis.
* Identify which events should be repeated, modified or discontinued based on commercial performance.


 6\. Corporate \& Group Business
 * Build relationships with corporate organisations and HR/Admin teams.
* Generate corporate dinners, team outings, celebrations and networking events.
* Build relationships with event agencies and party planners.
* Develop group\-booking opportunities.
* Create corporate packages in coordination with the management team.
* Develop recurring corporate business rather than only one\-time bookings.


 7\. Partnerships \& Collaborations
 
 Identify and build partnerships with:
 


* Lifestyle brands
* Beverage brands
* Event companies
* DJs and artists
* Influencers
* Fitness/lifestyle communities
* Corporate groups
* Colleges and alumni groups
* Social clubs
* Travel and hospitality partners



 Partnerships should have a clear objective such as
 **guest acquisition, revenue generation, brand exposure or repeat business.** 



 8\. Guest Experience \& Retention
 * Be present at key events and personally engage with guests.
* Identify VIPs, influencers, regular guests and potential high\-value customers.
* Maintain relationships after events.
* Encourage repeat visits and referrals.
* Capture guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve the experience.
* Build a strong database with guest preferences, occasions and engagement history.


 IDEAL CANDIDATEExperience
 * **3–6 years of experience** 
 in community management, events, nightlife, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment or business development.
* Experience in restaurants, bars, clubs, premium F\&B or lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Strong understanding of the
 **Kolkata social and nightlife ecosystem** 
 .


 Must\-Have
 
 The candidate should:
 


* **Know Kolkata's crowd.**
* Have an existing network or demonstrated ability to build one quickly.
* Be comfortable approaching people and building relationships.
* Have experience curating events.
* Understand what makes an event commercially successful.
* Be comfortable with sales and revenue targets.
* Understand basic P\&L and event profitability.
* Have strong negotiation skills.
* Be highly energetic and socially confident.
* Be hands\-on and present at events.
* Be able to convert relationships into actual business.


 IMPORTANT
 
**This is NOT a social\-media\-only Community Manager role.** 




 We are looking for someone who can:
 



**Build the community → Bring the guests → Curate the right events → Generate revenue → Control the costs → Make the events profitable.** 




 The candidate will be expected to have a
 **strong understanding of Kolkata's audience and social ecosystem** 
 and demonstrate how they can use their network and relationships to generate measurable business for Mehico.
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 Salary will be structured as
 **Fixed \+ Performance Incentive** 
 , with the variable component linked to agreed business and profitability targets.
